title.zh: 卷80 朱瑞 叱列延慶 斛斯椿 賈顯度 樊子鵠 賀拔勝 侯莫 陳悅 侯淵
title.en: Volume 80: Zhu Rui, Chilie Yanqing, Hu Sichun, Jia Xiandu, Fan Zihu, He Basheng, Houmochen Yue, Hou Yuan
title.raw: 卷80 朱瑞 叱列延慶 斛斯椿 賈顯度 樊子鵠 賀拔勝 侯莫陳悅 侯淵 Volume 80: Zhu Rui, Chilie Yanqing, Hu Sichun, Jia Xiandu, Fan Zihu, He Basheng, Houmochen Yue, Hou Yuan

sentences.zh: 朱瑞 叱列延慶 斛斯椿 賈顯度 樊子鵠 賀拔勝 侯莫陳悅 侯淵

translations.literal: Zhu Rui; Chilie Yanqing; Hu Sichun; Jia Xiandu; Fan Zihu; He Basheng; Houmochen Yue; Hou Yuan
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Rui; Chilie Yanqing; Hu Sichun; Jia Xiandu; Fan Zihu; He Basheng; Houmochen Yue; Hou Yuan

sentences.zh: 朱瑞，字元龍，代郡桑乾人。

translations.literal: Zhu Rui, courtesy name Yuanlong, was a native of Sanggan in Dai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Rui, whose courtesy name was Yuanlong, came from Sanggan in Dai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 祖就，字祖成，卒於沛縣令。

translations.literal: His grandfather Jiu, courtesy name Zucheng, died while serving as magistrate of Pei County.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jiu, courtesy name Zucheng, died in office as magistrate of Pei County.

sentences.zh: 父惠，字僧生，行太原太守，卒。

translations.literal: His father Hui, courtesy name Sengsheng, acted as administrator of Taiyuan and died.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hui, courtesy name Sengsheng, served as acting administrator of Taiyuan and died.

sentences.zh: 永安中，瑞貴達，就贈平東將軍、齊州刺史，惠贈使持節、冠軍將軍、恒州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Yong'an era, when Rui rose to prominence, Jiu was posthumously enfeoffed as General Who Pacifies the East and governor of Qi Province, and Hui was posthumously enfeoffed as Bearer of the Staff, General Who Conquers, and governor of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: During Yong'an, after Rui had risen to power, Jiu was posthumously made General Who Pacifies the East and governor of Qi Province, and Hui was posthumously made Bearer of the Staff, General Who Conquers, and governor of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 瑞長厚質直，敬愛人士。

translations.literal: Rui was generous, sincere, and upright, and he respected and cared for men of worth.
translations.idiomatic: Rui was generous, sincere, and upright, and he respected and cared for men of worth.

sentences.zh: 孝昌末，尒朱榮引為其府戶曹參軍，又為大行臺郎中，甚為榮所親任。

translations.literal: At the end of the Xiaochang era, Erzhu Rong brought him into his staff as Registrar of the Household, then as Gentleman of the Grand Forward Office; Rong trusted and relied on him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Xiaochang era, Erzhu Rong brought him onto his staff as registrar of the household and then as gentleman of the grand forward office; Rong trusted and relied on him greatly.

sentences.zh: 建義初，除黃門侍郎，仍中書舍人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi, he was appointed Gentleman at the Yellow Gate and concurrently Palace Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Jianyi, he was appointed gentleman at the Yellow Gate and concurrently palace secretary.

sentences.zh: 榮恐朝廷事意有所不知，故居之門下，為腹心之寄。

translations.literal: Rong feared that the court's intentions might be unknown to him, so he kept Rui at his gate as a trusted confidant.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing he might not know the court's intentions, Rong kept Rui at his gate as a trusted confidant.

sentences.zh: 錄前後勳，封陽邑縣開國公，食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: Recording his earlier and later merit, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yangyi County with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: For his accumulated merit he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yangyi County with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 未幾，又除散騎常侍、安南將軍，黃門如故。

translations.literal: Before long he was also appointed Regular Attendant and General Who Pacifies the South, retaining his Yellow Gate post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was also appointed regular attendant and General Who Pacifies the South, while retaining his Yellow Gate post.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，去官。

translations.literal: Upon entering mourning for his father, he left office.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he left office to mourn.

sentences.zh: 詔起復任，除青州大中正。

translations.literal: An edict recalled him to service and appointed him Chief Rectifier of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled him to service and appointed him chief rectifier of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 及元顥內逼，瑞啟勸北幸，乃從駕於河陽，除侍中、征南將軍、兼吏部尚書，改封北海郡開國公，增邑一千戶。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao pressed inward, Rui memorialized urging the emperor to flee north; he then accompanied the imperial carriage to Heyang and was appointed Palace Attendant, General Who Campaigns South, and Concurrent Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, with his title changed to Duke of Beihai Commandery and his fief increased by one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao pressed inward, Rui memorialized urging a northern flight; he accompanied the imperial carriage to Heyang and was appointed palace attendant, General Who Campaigns South, and concurrent minister of the Ministry of Personnel, with his title changed to Duke of Beihai Commandery and his fief increased by one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 莊帝還洛，加衞將軍、左光祿大夫，又改封樂陵郡開國公，仍侍中，瑞雖為尒朱榮所委，而善處朝廷之間，莊帝亦賞遇之，曾謂侍臣曰：「為人臣當須忠實，至如朱元龍者，朕待之亦不異餘人。」

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang returned to Luoyang, Rui was promoted to General of the Guard and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, then his title was changed again to Duke of Leling Commandery while he remained Palace Attendant. Though Rui was entrusted by Erzhu Rong, he handled himself well between court factions, and Emperor Zhuang also favored him. He once told his attendants, "As a minister one must be loyal and sincere; as with Zhu Yuanlong, I treat him no differently from the rest."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang returned to Luoyang, Rui was promoted to General of the Guard and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, then his title was changed again to Duke of Leling Commandery while he remained palace attendant. Though entrusted by Erzhu Rong, Rui navigated court relations well, and Emperor Zhuang favored him as well. He once told his attendants, "A minister must be loyal and sincere; as with Zhu Yuanlong, I treat him no differently from anyone else."

sentences.zh: 瑞啟乞三從之內並屬滄州樂陵郡，詔許之，仍轉滄州大中正。

translations.literal: Rui memorialized asking that all kin within three collateral degrees be registered under Leling Commandery in Cang Province; the edict granted this, and he was transferred to Chief Rectifier of Cang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Rui memorialized asking that all kin within three collateral degrees be registered under Leling Commandery in Cang Province; the edict granted this, and he was transferred to chief rectifier of Cang Province.

sentences.zh: 瑞始以青州樂陵有朱氏，意欲歸之，故求為青州中正；

translations.literal: At first, because there was a Zhu clan in Leling in Qing Province, Rui wished to join them and therefore sought appointment as Chief Rectifier of Qing Province;
translations.idiomatic: At first, because there was a Zhu clan in Leling, Qing Province, Rui wished to join them and therefore sought appointment as chief rectifier of Qing Province;

sentences.zh: 又以滄州樂陵亦有朱氏，而心好河北，遂乞移屬焉。

translations.literal: then, because Leling in Cang Province also had a Zhu clan and his heart favored Hebei, he asked to be transferred there instead.
translations.idiomatic: then, because Leling in Cang Province also had a Zhu clan and his heart favored Hebei, he asked to be transferred there instead.

sentences.zh: 尋加車騎將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was further promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was further promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮死，瑞與世隆俱北走。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Rui fled north together with Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Rui fled north together with Shilong.

sentences.zh: 既而以莊帝待之素厚，且見世隆等並無雄才，終當敗喪，於路乃還。

translations.literal: But because Emperor Zhuang had always treated him generously, and because he saw that Shilong and the others lacked heroic talent and would ultimately meet defeat, he turned back on the road.
translations.idiomatic: But because Emperor Zhuang had always treated him generously, and because he saw that Shilong and the others lacked heroic talent and would ultimately meet defeat, he turned back on the road.

sentences.zh: 帝大悅，執其手曰：「社稷忠臣，當須如此。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased, took his hand, and said, "A loyal minister of the state must act as you have.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased, took his hand, and said, "A loyal minister of the state must act as you have.

sentences.zh: 」尒朱天光擁眾關右，帝欲招納之，乃以瑞兼尚書左僕射為西道大行臺以慰勞焉。

translations.literal: " Erzhu Tianguang held a large force in the Guanzhong region; the emperor wished to win him over and therefore made Rui Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Commissioner of the Western Route to console and reassure him.
translations.idiomatic: " Erzhu Tianguang held a large force in the Guanzhong region; the emperor wished to win him over and therefore made Rui concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing and grand commissioner of the western route to console and reassure him.

sentences.zh: 既達長安，會尒朱兆入洛，復還京師。

translations.literal: After reaching Chang'an, he encountered Erzhu Zhao entering Luoyang and returned again to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After reaching Chang'an, he encountered Erzhu Zhao entering Luoyang and returned again to the capital.

sentences.zh: 都督斛斯椿先與瑞有隙，數譖之於世隆。

translations.literal: The commander Husi Chun had earlier been at odds with Rui and repeatedly slandered him to Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: The commander Hu Sichun had earlier been at odds with Rui and repeatedly slandered him to Shilong.

sentences.zh: 世隆性多忌，且以前日乖異，忿恨更甚，普泰元年七月，遂誅之，時年四十九。

translations.literal: Shilong was by nature much given to suspicion, and because of their earlier breach his resentment grew even stronger; in the seventh month of the first year of Putai he had Rui executed, at age forty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong was by nature much given to suspicion, and because of their earlier breach his resentment grew even stronger; in the seventh month of the first year of Putai he had Rui executed, at age forty-nine.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，贈使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、青州刺史，諡曰恭穆。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang he was posthumously enfeoffed as Bearer of the Staff, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and governor of Qing Province, with the posthumous title Gongmu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang he was posthumously enfeoffed as bearer of the staff, grand general of agile cavalry, grand commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and governor of Qing Province, with the posthumous title Gongmu.

sentences.zh: 子孟胤，襲封。

translations.literal: His son Mengyin inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mengyin inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 齊受禪，例降。

translations.literal: When Qi received the abdication, the title was reduced by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi received the abdication, the title was reduced by precedent.

sentences.zh: 瑞弟珍，字多寶。

translations.literal: Rui's younger brother Zhen, courtesy name Duobao.
translations.idiomatic: Rui's younger brother Zhen, courtesy name Duobao.

sentences.zh: 太尉、上黨王天穆錄事參軍。

translations.literal: Recorder of the Grand Commandant, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as recorder to the Grand Commandant, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 珍弟騰，字神龍。

translations.literal: Zhen's younger brother Teng, courtesy name Shenlong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen's younger brother Teng, courtesy name Shenlong.

sentences.zh: 建義初，為龍驤將軍、大都督司馬。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi he was made General of Dragon Cavalry and Chief of Staff to the Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Jianyi he was made General of Dragon Cavalry and chief of staff to the grand commander.

sentences.zh: 又封涇陽縣開國男，食邑二百戶。

translations.literal: He was also enfeoffed as Baron of Jingyang County with a fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was also enfeoffed as Baron of Jingyang County with a fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 累遷中軍將軍、光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Through successive promotions he rose to General of the Central Army and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive promotions he rose to General of the Central Army and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 與瑞同遇害。

translations.literal: He was killed together with Rui.
translations.idiomatic: He was killed together with Rui.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，贈滄州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang he was posthumously enfeoffed as governor of Cang Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang he was posthumously enfeoffed as governor of Cang Province.

sentences.zh: 騰弟慶賓，卒於光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Teng's younger brother Qingbin died while serving as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Teng's younger brother Qingbin died while serving as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 子清，武定末，齊王開府中兵參軍。

translations.literal: His son Qing, at the end of Wuding, was Middle Army Aide in the Prince of Qi's command.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qing, at the end of Wuding, was middle army aide in the Prince of Qi's command.

sentences.zh: 叱列延慶，代西部人也，世為酋帥。

translations.literal: Chilie Yanqing was a man of the western part of Dai; for generations his family had been tribal chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Chilie Yanqing was a man of the western part of Dai; for generations his family had been tribal chiefs.

sentences.zh: 曾祖鍮石，世祖末從駕至瓜步，賜爵臨江伯。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Toushi, at the end of Emperor Shizu's reign, accompanied the imperial carriage to Guabu and was granted the title Baron of Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Toushi, at the end of Emperor Shizu's reign, accompanied the imperial carriage to Guabu and was granted the title Baron of Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 父億彌，襲祖爵，高祖時越騎校尉。

translations.literal: His father Yimi inherited his grandfather's title and, in Emperor Gaozu's time, served as Colonel of Flying Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yimi inherited his grandfather's title and, in Emperor Gaozu's time, served as Colonel of Flying Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 延慶少便弓馬，有膽力。

translations.literal: Yanqing from youth was skilled with bow and horse and had courage and strength.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Yanqing was skilled with bow and horse and had courage and strength.

sentences.zh: 正光末，除直後，隸大都督李崇北伐。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenguang he was appointed Attendant-in-Waiting and placed under the Grand Commander Li Chong for the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenguang he was appointed attendant-in-waiting and placed under Grand Commander Li Chong for the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 後隨尒朱榮入洛，仍從榮討葛榮於相州。

translations.literal: Later he followed Erzhu Rong into Luoyang and still followed Rong to campaign against Ge Rong at Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Erzhu Rong into Luoyang and still followed Rong to campaign against Ge Rong at Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 延慶，世隆姊壻也，榮親遇之。

translations.literal: Yanqing was Shilong's sister's husband, and Rong treated him with special favor.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing was Shilong's sister's husband, and Rong treated him with special favor.

sentences.zh: 葛榮既擒，除使持節、撫軍將軍、光祿大夫、假鎮東將軍、都督、西部第一領民酋長，封永寧縣開國伯，食邑五百戶。

translations.literal: After Ge Rong was captured, Yanqing was appointed Bearer of the Staff, General Who Pacifies the Army, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting General Who Garrisons the East, Commander, Chief of the First Western Tribal Regiment, and enfeoffed as Baron of Yongning County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: After Ge Rong was captured, Yanqing was appointed bearer of the staff, General Who Pacifies the Army, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting General Who Garrisons the East, commander, chief of the first western tribal regiment, and enfeoffed as Baron of Yongning County with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 永安二年，以本將軍除恒州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yong'an he was appointed governor of Heng Province with his existing rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yong'an he was appointed governor of Heng Province with his existing rank.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，世隆得志，特見委重，遷散騎常侍、車騎將軍、儀同三司，又進驃騎大將軍、開府，餘如故。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai, when Shilong gained his aims, Yanqing was especially entrusted; he was promoted to Regular Attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, then further to Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Grand Commander, with the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai, when Shilong gained his aims, Yanqing was especially entrusted; he was promoted to regular attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, then further to grand general of agile cavalry and grand commander, with the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 尋除都督恒雲燕朔四州諸軍事、大都督、兼尚書左僕射、山東行臺，北海郡開國公，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of the four provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, and Shuo, Grand Commander, Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Commissioner of the Eastern Mountain Route, and Duke of Beihai Commandery with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed commander-in-chief over the military affairs of the four provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, and Shuo, grand commander, concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing, commissioner of the eastern mountain route, and Duke of Beihai Commandery with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 時幽州刺史劉靈助以莊帝幽崩，遂舉兵唱義，諸州豪右咸相結附。

translations.literal: At that time the governor of You Province, Liu Lingzhu, because Emperor Zhuang had died in You, raised troops in righteous rebellion, and powerful men of the provinces all joined him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liu Lingzhu, governor of You Province, because Emperor Zhuang had died in You, raised troops in righteous rebellion, and powerful men of the provinces all joined him.

sentences.zh: 靈助進屯於定州之安固，世隆白前廢帝，以延慶與大都督侯淵於定州相會，以討靈助。

translations.literal: Lingzhu advanced and encamped at Angu in Ding Province; Shilong reported to the deposed emperor and sent Yanqing together with the Grand Commander Hou Yuan to meet at Ding Province to campaign against Lingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhu advanced and encamped at Angu in Ding Province; Shilong reported to the deposed emperor and sent Yanqing together with Grand Commander Hou Yuan to meet at Ding Province to campaign against Lingzhu.

sentences.zh: 淵謂延慶曰：「靈助善於卜占，百姓信惑，所在響應，未易可圖，若萬一戰有利鈍，則大事去矣。

translations.literal: Hou Yuan said to Yanqing, "Lingzhu is skilled at divination; the people believe and are confused, and everywhere they respond to him. He is not easy to take. If by any chance the battle goes well or badly, the great enterprise will be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Yuan said to Yanqing, "Lingzhu is skilled at divination; the people believe and are confused, and everywhere they respond to him. He is not easy to take. If by any chance the battle goes well or badly, the great enterprise will be lost.

sentences.zh: 未若還師西入，據關拒險，以待其變。

translations.literal: Better to withdraw the army westward, enter the passes, hold the defiles, and wait for changes.
translations.idiomatic: Better to withdraw the army westward, enter the passes, hold the defiles, and wait for changes.

sentences.zh: 」延慶曰：「劉靈助，庸人也。

translations.literal: " Yanqing said, "Liu Lingzhu is a mediocre man.
translations.idiomatic: " Yanqing said, "Liu Lingzhu is a mediocre man.

sentences.zh: 天道深遠，豈其所識。

translations.literal: The Way of Heaven is profound and far; how could he understand it?
translations.idiomatic: The Way of Heaven is profound and far; how could he understand it?

sentences.zh: 大兵一臨，彼皆恃其妖術，坐看符厭，寧肯戮力致死，與吾爭勝負哉。

translations.literal: When our great army arrives, they will all rely on their sorceries, sit watching talismans and curses—would they rather exert themselves to the death and contend with us for victory?
translations.idiomatic: When our great army arrives, they will all rely on their sorceries, sit watching talismans and curses—would they rather exert themselves to the death and contend with us for victory?

sentences.zh: 如吾計者，政欲出營城外，詭言西歸，靈助聞之，必信而自寬，潛軍往襲，可一往而擒。

translations.literal: As I plan it, we should simply leave camp outside the walls, falsely announce a withdrawal westward; when Lingzhu hears it he will surely believe and relax, and if we secretly send troops to strike we can capture him in one move.
translations.idiomatic: As I plan it, we should simply leave camp outside the walls and falsely announce a withdrawal westward; when Lingzhu hears it he will surely believe and relax, and if we secretly send troops to strike we can capture him in one move.

sentences.zh: 」淵從之，乃出頓城西，聲云將還。

translations.literal: " Yuan agreed; they then went out and encamped west of the city, proclaiming that they would return.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuan agreed; they then went out and encamped west of the city, proclaiming that they would return.

sentences.zh: 簡精騎一千夜發，詰朝造靈助壘，戰於城北，遂破擒之。

translations.literal: They selected one thousand elite horsemen and set out by night; at dawn they reached Lingzhu's camp, fought north of the city, and broke his force and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: They selected one thousand elite horsemen and set out by night; at dawn they reached Lingzhu's camp, fought north of the city, and broke his force and captured him.

sentences.zh: 仍兼尚書左僕射，為恒、雲、燕、朔四州行臺。

translations.literal: He was still made Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Commissioner of the Route for the four provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, and Shuo.
translations.idiomatic: He was still made concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing and commissioner of the route for the four provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, and Shuo.

sentences.zh: 又除使持節、侍中、都督恒雲燕朔定五州諸軍事、定州刺史，餘如故。

translations.literal: He was further appointed Bearer of the Staff, Palace Attendant, Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of the five provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, Shuo, and Ding, and governor of Ding Province, with the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: He was further appointed bearer of the staff, palace attendant, commander-in-chief over the military affairs of the five provinces of Heng, Yun, Yan, Shuo, and Ding, and governor of Ding Province, with the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 與尒朱兆等拒義旗於韓陵，戰敗，延慶與尒朱仲遠走渡石濟。

translations.literal: Together with Erzhu Zhao and the others he resisted the righteous banner at Hanling, was defeated, and Yanqing fled with Erzhu Zhongyuan, crossing the Shiji ford.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Erzhu Zhao and the others he resisted the righteous banner at Hanling, was defeated, and Yanqing fled with Erzhu Zhongyuan, crossing the Shiji ford.

sentences.zh: 仲遠南竄，延慶北降齊獻武王。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan fled south; Yanqing surrendered north to King Xianwu of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan fled south; Yanqing surrendered north to King Xianwu of Qi.

sentences.zh: 王與之入洛，仍從王於并州。

translations.literal: The king entered Luoyang with him and still had him follow to Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: The king entered Luoyang with him and still had him follow to Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 後赴洛，出帝以為中軍大都督。

translations.literal: Later he went to Luoyang, and the Deposed Emperor made him Grand Commander of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: Later he went to Luoyang, and the Deposed Emperor made him grand commander of the central army.

sentences.zh: 延慶既尒朱親昵，又黨於權佞，出帝之西，齊獻武王入洛。

translations.literal: Yanqing was both close to the Erzhu and allied with powerful sycophants; when the Deposed Emperor went west, King Xianwu of Qi entered Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing was both close to the Erzhu and allied with powerful sycophants; when the Deposed Emperor went west, King Xianwu of Qi entered Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 以罪誅之。

translations.literal: He was executed for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: He was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 延慶兄子平，武定末，儀同三司、右衞將軍、廮陶縣開國侯。

translations.literal: Yanqing's elder brother's son Ping, at the end of Wuding, held the rank of Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, General of the Right Guard, and Marquis of Yingtao County.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing's elder brother's son Ping, at the end of Wuding, held the rank of equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, General of the Right Guard, and Marquis of Yingtao County.

sentences.zh: 斛斯椿，字法壽，廣牧富昌人也。

translations.literal: Hu Sichun, courtesy name Fashou, was a native of Fuchang in Guangmu.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sichun, courtesy name Fashou, was a native of Fuchang in Guangmu.

sentences.zh: 父敦，肅宗時為左牧令。

translations.literal: His father Dun, in Emperor Suzong's time, was Director of the Left Pasturage.
translations.idiomatic: His father Dun, in Emperor Suzong's time, was director of the left pasturage.

sentences.zh: 時河西賊起，牧民不安，椿乃將家投尒朱榮，榮以椿兼其都督府鎧曹參軍。

translations.literal: When bandits rose in the Hexi region and the herding peoples were unsettled, Chun led his family to join Erzhu Rong, and Rong made Chun concurrently Registrar of Armor in his commandery staff.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose in the Hexi region and the herding peoples were unsettled, Chun led his family to join Erzhu Rong, and Rong made Chun concurrently registrar of armor in his commandery staff.

sentences.zh: 從榮征伐有功，表授厲威將軍。

translations.literal: Following Rong on campaigns he had merit, and by memorial he was appointed General of Awesome Prestige.
translations.idiomatic: Following Rong on campaigns he had merit, and by memorial he was appointed General of Awesome Prestige.

sentences.zh: 稍遷中散大夫，署外兵事。

translations.literal: He was gradually promoted to Palace Gentleman and was charged with external military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was gradually promoted to palace gentleman and was charged with external military affairs.

sentences.zh: 椿性佞巧，甚得榮心，軍之密謀，頗亦關預。

translations.literal: Chun was by nature sycophantic and crafty and greatly won Rong's heart; he also participated extensively in the army's secret plans.
translations.idiomatic: Chun was by nature sycophantic and crafty and greatly won Rong's heart; he also participated extensively in the army's secret plans.

sentences.zh: 及肅宗崩，椿從榮入洛。

translations.literal: When Emperor Suzong died, Chun followed Rong into Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Suzong died, Chun followed Rong into Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 莊帝初，封陽曲縣開國公，食邑千戶，遷散騎常侍、平北將軍司馬，尋除尒朱榮大將軍府司馬。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yangqu County with a fief of one thousand households, promoted to Regular Attendant and Chief of Staff to the General Who Pacifies the North, and soon appointed Chief of Staff in Erzhu Rong's Grand General's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yangqu County with a fief of one thousand households, promoted to regular attendant and chief of staff to the General Who Pacifies the North, and soon appointed chief of staff in Erzhu Rong's grand general's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 從平葛榮，以功除上黨太守。

translations.literal: Following the pacification of Ge Rong, for merit he was appointed Administrator of Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Following the pacification of Ge Rong, for merit he was appointed administrator of Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 及元顥入洛，椿隨榮奉迎莊帝，遂從攻顥。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Chun followed Rong to welcome Emperor Zhuang and then joined the attack on Hao.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Chun followed Rong to welcome Emperor Zhuang and then joined the attack on Hao.

sentences.zh: 顥敗，遷安北將軍、建州刺史，改封深澤縣，轉鎮東將軍、徐州刺史，又轉征東將軍、東徐州刺史。

translations.literal: When Hao was defeated, Chun was transferred to General Who Pacifies the North and governor of Jian Province, his title changed to Duke of Shenze County, then to General Who Garrisons the East and governor of Xu Province, and again to General Who Campaigns East and governor of Eastern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Hao was defeated, Chun was transferred to General Who Pacifies the North and governor of Jian Province, his title changed to Duke of Shenze County, then to General Who Garrisons the East and governor of Xu Province, and again to General Who Campaigns East and governor of Eastern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 及尒朱榮死，椿甚憂懼。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Chun was greatly fearful.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Chun was greatly fearful.

sentences.zh: 時蕭衍以汝南王悅為魏主，資其士馬，次於境上。

translations.literal: At that time Xiao Yan set up the Prince of Runan, Yue, as ruler of Wei, supplied him with troops and horses, and halted on the border.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiao Yan set up the Prince of Runan, Yue, as ruler of Wei, supplied him with troops and horses, and halted on the border.

sentences.zh: 椿聞大喜，遂率所部棄州歸悅，悅授椿使持節、侍中、大將軍、領軍將軍、領左右、尚書左僕射、司空公，封靈丘郡開國公，邑萬戶，又為大行臺前驅都督。

translations.literal: Chun heard this with great joy, then led his command, abandoning his province, to join Yue; Yue enfeoffed Chun as Bearer of the Staff, Palace Attendant, Grand General, General of the Garrison Army, Director of the Left and Right, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Duke of Works, and Duke of Lingqiu Commandery with a fief of ten thousand households, and also made him Vanguard Commander of the Grand Forward Office.
translations.idiomatic: Chun heard this with great joy, then led his command, abandoning his province, to join Yue; Yue enfeoffed Chun as bearer of the staff, palace attendant, grand general, general of the garrison army, director of the left and right, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, duke of works, and Duke of Lingqiu Commandery with a fief of ten thousand households, and also made him vanguard commander of the grand forward office.

sentences.zh: 會尒朱兆入洛，椿復率所部背悅歸兆。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Zhao entered Luoyang, Chun again led his command, turning against Yue, to join Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Zhao entered Luoyang, Chun again led his command, turning against Yue, to join Zhao.

sentences.zh: 尒朱世隆之立前廢帝也，椿參其謀，以定策功，拜侍中、驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、京畿北面大都督，改封城陽郡開國公，增邑五百戶，并前一千五百戶，尋加開府。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Shilong enthroned the deposed emperor, Chun took part in the plot; for his merit in settling the succession he was appointed Palace Attendant, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, Grand Commander of the Northern Capital Region, with his title changed to Duke of Chengyang Commandery and his fief increased by five hundred households to one thousand five hundred in all, and soon given the Grand Commander's seal.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Shilong enthroned the deposed emperor, Chun took part in the plot; for his merit in settling the succession he was appointed palace attendant, grand general of agile cavalry, equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, grand commander of the northern capital region, with his title changed to Duke of Chengyang Commandery and his fief increased by five hundred households to one thousand five hundred in all, and soon given the grand commander's seal.

sentences.zh: 時椿父敦先在秀容，忽有傳敦死問，請減己階以贈之，自襄威將軍超贈車騎將軍、[1]恒州刺史。

translations.literal: At that time Chun's father Dun was still at Xiurong when suddenly there came word that Dun had died; Chun asked to reduce his own rank to posthumously enfeoff him, promoting him from General of Awesome Prestige beyond precedent to General of Chariots and Cavalry,[1] and governor of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chun's father Dun was still at Xiurong when suddenly there came word that Dun had died; Chun asked to reduce his own rank to posthumously enfeoff him, promoting him from General of Awesome Prestige beyond precedent to General of Chariots and Cavalry,[1] and governor of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 尋知其父猶在，詔復椿官，仍除其父為車騎將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon it was learned that his father was still alive; an edict restored Chun's offices and also appointed his father General of Chariots and Cavalry and governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it was learned that his father was still alive; an edict restored Chun's offices and also appointed his father General of Chariots and Cavalry and governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 世隆之厚椿也如此。

translations.literal: Such was the favor Shilong showed Chun.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the favor Shilong showed Chun.

sentences.zh: 椿與尒朱度律、仲遠等北拒齊獻武王，次陽平。

translations.literal: Chun, together with Erzhu Dulu, Zhongyuan, and the others, went north to resist King Xianwu of Qi and halted at Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: Chun, together with Erzhu Dulu, Zhongyuan, and the others, went north to resist King Xianwu of Qi and halted at Yangping.

sentences.zh: 會尒朱兆與度律等相疑遁還，語在兆傳。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Zhao and Dulu and the others grew suspicious of one another and withdrew, the account is given in Zhao's biography.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Zhao and Dulu and the others grew suspicious of one another and withdrew, the account is given in Zhao's biography.

sentences.zh: 椿後復與度律等同拒義旗，敗於韓陵。

translations.literal: Later Chun again joined Dulu and the others in resisting the righteous banner and was defeated at Hanling.
translations.idiomatic: Later Chun again joined Dulu and the others in resisting the righteous banner and was defeated at Hanling.

sentences.zh: 椿謂都督賈顯智等曰：「若不先執尒朱，我等死無類矣。

translations.literal: Chun said to the commander Jia Xianzhi and the others, "If we do not seize the Erzhu first, we shall die without remnant.
translations.idiomatic: Chun said to the commander Jia Xianzhi and the others, "If we do not seize the Erzhu first, we shall die without remnant.

sentences.zh: 」遂與顯智等夜於桑下盟約，倍道兼行。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he and Xianzhi and the others made a pact by night under a mulberry tree and pressed forward at double speed.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he and Xianzhi and the others made a pact by night under a mulberry tree and pressed forward at double speed.

sentences.zh: 椿入北中城，收尒朱部曲盡殺之，令長孫稚、賈顯智等率數百騎襲尒朱世隆、彥伯兄弟，斬於閶闔門外。

translations.literal: Chun entered Beizhong Fortress, gathered the Erzhu retainers and killed them all, and ordered Zhangsun Zhi, Jia Xianzhi, and the others to lead several hundred horsemen in a surprise attack on Erzhu Shilong and the Yanbo brothers, beheading them outside the Changhe Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Chun entered Beizhong Fortress, gathered the Erzhu retainers and killed them all, and ordered Zhangsun Zhi, Jia Xianzhi, and the others to lead several hundred horsemen in a surprise attack on Erzhu Shilong and the Yanbo brothers, beheading them outside the Changhe Gate.

sentences.zh: 椿入洛，懸世隆兄弟首於其門樹。

translations.literal: Chun entered Luoyang and hung the heads of Shilong and his brothers on the trees at his gate.
translations.idiomatic: Chun entered Luoyang and hung the heads of Shilong and his brothers on the trees at his gate.

sentences.zh: 椿父出見，謂椿曰：「汝與尒朱約為兄弟，今何忍懸其頭於家門，寧不愧負天地乎！

translations.literal: Chun's father came out to see him and said to Chun, "You swore brotherhood with the Erzhu—how can you bear to hang their heads at the family gate? Are you not ashamed before Heaven and Earth?
translations.idiomatic: Chun's father came out to see him and said to Chun, "You swore brotherhood with the Erzhu—how can you bear to hang their heads at the family gate? Are you not ashamed before Heaven and Earth?

sentences.zh: 」椿乃傳世隆等首，并囚度律、天光，送於齊獻武王。

translations.literal: " Chun then sent on the heads of Shilong and the others, and also imprisoned Dulu and Tianguang and sent them to King Xianwu of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: " Chun then sent on the heads of Shilong and the others, and also imprisoned Dulu and Tianguang and sent them to King Xianwu of Qi.

sentences.zh: 出帝拜椿侍中、儀同開府。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor enfeoffed Chun as Palace Attendant and Grand Commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor enfeoffed Chun as palace attendant and grand commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 初，獻武王之入洛，頓於邙山，尒朱仲遠帳下都督橋寧、張子期自滑臺而至。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the King Xianwu entered Luoyang, he halted at Mount Mang; the commanders Qiao Ning and Zhang Ziqi under Erzhu Zhongyuan came from Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when King Xianwu entered Luoyang, he halted at Mount Mang; the commanders Qiao Ning and Zhang Ziqi under Erzhu Zhongyuan came from Huatai.

sentences.zh: 獻武王責寧等曰：「汝事仲遠，擅其榮利，盟契百重，許同生死。

translations.literal: The King Xianwu rebuked Ning and the others, saying, "You served Zhongyuan, monopolized his honors and profits, swore oaths a hundredfold, and promised to live and die together.
translations.idiomatic: King Xianwu rebuked Ning and the others, saying, "You served Zhongyuan, monopolized his honors and profits, swore oaths a hundredfold, and promised to live and die together.

sentences.zh: 前仲遠自徐為逆，汝為戎首，今仲遠南走，汝復背之。

translations.literal: Earlier Zhongyuan rebelled from Xu and you were the ringleader; now Zhongyuan flees south and you turn against him again.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhongyuan rebelled from Xu and you were the ringleader; now Zhongyuan flees south and you turn against him again.

sentences.zh: 於臣節則不忠，論事人則無信。

translations.literal: As ministers you are disloyal; as men who deal with others you are faithless.
translations.idiomatic: As ministers you are disloyal; as men who deal with others you are faithless.

sentences.zh: 犬馬尚識恩養，汝今犬馬之不如！

translations.literal: Even dogs and horses know gratitude for kindness—today you are worse than dogs and horses!
translations.idiomatic: Even dogs and horses know gratitude for kindness—today you are worse than dogs and horses!

sentences.zh: 」遂斬之。

translations.literal: " He then had them beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: " He then had them beheaded.

sentences.zh: 椿自以數為反覆，見寧等之死，意常不安。

translations.literal: Chun, having repeatedly switched sides, was constantly uneasy upon seeing the deaths of Ning and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Chun, having repeatedly switched sides, was constantly uneasy upon seeing the deaths of Ning and the others.

sentences.zh: 遂密構間，勸出帝置閤內都督部曲，又增武直人數，自直閤已下員別數百，皆選天下輕剽者以充之。

translations.literal: He then secretly sowed discord, urging the Deposed Emperor to establish commanders' retainers within the palace, and also increased the number of martial guards; from Attendants-in-Waiting downward he appointed several hundred men, all chosen from the most reckless men in the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He then secretly sowed discord, urging the Deposed Emperor to establish commanders' retainers within the palace, and also increased the number of martial guards; from attendants-in-waiting downward he appointed several hundred men, all chosen from the most reckless men in the realm.

sentences.zh: 又說帝數出遊幸，號令部曲，別為行陳，椿自約勒，指麾其間。

translations.literal: He also persuaded the emperor to go out frequently on tours, giving orders to his retainers and arranging them in separate formations, with Chun himself restraining and directing them.
translations.idiomatic: He also persuaded the emperor to go out frequently on tours, giving orders to his retainers and arranging them in separate formations, with Chun himself restraining and directing them.

sentences.zh: 從此以後，軍謀朝政，一決於椿。

translations.literal: From this time forward, military plans and court policy were decided entirely by Chun.
translations.idiomatic: From this time forward, military plans and court policy were decided entirely by Chun.

sentences.zh: 又勸帝徵兵，詭稱南討，將以伐齊獻武王，帝從之。

translations.literal: He also urged the emperor to levy troops, falsely claiming a southern campaign in order to attack King Xianwu of Qi, and the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: He also urged the emperor to levy troops, falsely claiming a southern campaign in order to attack King Xianwu of Qi, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 遂陳兵城西，北接邙山，南至洛水，帝詰旦戎服與椿臨閱焉。

translations.literal: They then arrayed troops west of the city, north to Mount Mang and south to the Luo River; at dawn the emperor put on armor and reviewed them with Chun.
translations.idiomatic: They then arrayed troops west of the city, north to Mount Mang and south to the Luo River; at dawn the emperor put on armor and reviewed them with Chun.

sentences.zh: 獻武王以椿亂政，欲誅之。

translations.literal: King Xianwu, because Chun was disrupting government, wished to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: King Xianwu, because Chun was disrupting government, wished to execute him.

sentences.zh: 椿譖說既行，因此遂相恐動。

translations.literal: Chun's slander and persuasion had already taken effect, and therefore mutual alarm and agitation followed.
translations.idiomatic: Chun's slander and persuasion had already taken effect, and therefore mutual alarm and agitation followed.

sentences.zh: 出帝勒兵河橋，令椿為前軍，營於邙山北。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor mustered troops at Heqiao Bridge and made Chun vanguard, encamping north of Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor mustered troops at Heqiao Bridge and made Chun vanguard, encamping north of Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 尋遣椿率步騎數千鎮虎牢。

translations.literal: Soon he sent Chun to lead several thousand infantry and cavalry to garrison Hulao.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he sent Chun to lead several thousand infantry and cavalry to garrison Hulao.

sentences.zh: 椿弟豫州刺史元壽與都督賈顯智守滑臺，獻武王令相州刺史竇泰擊破之。

translations.literal: Chun's younger brother Yuanshou, governor of Yu Province, and the commander Jia Xianzhi defended Huatai; King Xianwu ordered Dou Tai, governor of Xiang Province, to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Chun's younger brother Yuanshou, governor of Yu Province, and the commander Jia Xianzhi defended Huatai; King Xianwu ordered Dou Tai, governor of Xiang Province, to defeat them.

sentences.zh: 椿懼己不免，復啟出帝，假說遊聲以劫脅。

translations.literal: Chun, fearing he could not escape, again memorialized the Deposed Emperor, using false reports of enemy movements to coerce him.
translations.idiomatic: Chun, fearing he could not escape, again memorialized the Deposed Emperor, using false reports of enemy movements to coerce him.

sentences.zh: 帝信之，遂入關，椿亦西走長安。

translations.literal: The emperor believed him, then entered the passes, and Chun also fled west to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor believed him, then entered the passes, and Chun also fled west to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 椿狡猾多事，好亂樂禍，干時敗國，朝野莫不讎疾之。

translations.literal: Chun was cunning and meddlesome, delighted in chaos and calamity, ruined the times and brought down the state; court and countryside alike hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Chun was cunning and meddlesome, delighted in chaos and calamity, ruined the times and brought down the state; court and countryside alike hated him.

sentences.zh: 元壽尋為部下所殺。

translations.literal: Yuanshou was soon killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshou was soon killed by his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 賈顯度，中山無極人。

translations.literal: Jia Xiandu was a native of Wuji in Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Xiandu was a native of Wuji in Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 父道監，沃野鎮長史。

translations.literal: His father Daojian was Chief Clerk of Woye Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: His father Daojian was chief clerk of Woye Garrison.

sentences.zh: 顯度形貌偉壯，有志氣。

translations.literal: Xiandu was imposing in stature and had ambition and spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Xiandu was imposing in stature and had ambition and spirit.

sentences.zh: 初為別將，防守薄骨律鎮。

translations.literal: At first he was a separate commander defending Boguli Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was a separate commander defending Boguli Garrison.

sentences.zh: 正光末，北鎮擾亂，為賊攻圍。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenguang the northern garrisons were in turmoil and he was besieged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenguang the northern garrisons were in turmoil and he was besieged by bandits.

sentences.zh: 顯度拒守多時，以賊勢轉熾，不可久立，乃率鎮民浮河而下。

translations.literal: Xiandu held out for a long time, but as the bandits' strength grew and he could not stand long, he led the garrison people downriver by boat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiandu held out for a long time, but as the bandits' strength grew and he could not stand long, he led the garrison people downriver by boat.

sentences.zh: 既達秀容，為尒朱榮所留。

translations.literal: After reaching Xiurong he was detained by Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: After reaching Xiurong he was detained by Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 尋表授直閤將軍、左中郎將。

translations.literal: Soon by memorial he was appointed General of the Direct Gate and Left Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon by memorial he was appointed General of the Direct Gate and Left Commandant.

sentences.zh: 建義初，除汲郡太守，假平東將軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi he was appointed Administrator of Ji Commandery and Acting General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Jianyi he was appointed administrator of Ji Commandery and acting General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 隨尒朱榮破葛榮，又除撫軍將軍、光祿大夫、都督，封石艾縣開國公，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: Following Erzhu Rong in defeating Ge Rong, he was further appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Commander, and enfeoffed as Duke of Shi'ai County with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Following Erzhu Rong in defeating Ge Rong, he was further appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and commander, and enfeoffed as Duke of Shi'ai County with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 從上黨王天穆破邢杲。

translations.literal: He followed Prince of Shangdang Tianmu in defeating Xing Gao.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince of Shangdang Tianmu in defeating Xing Gao.

sentences.zh: 值元顥入洛，仍與天穆渡河赴行宮於河內。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, he still crossed the river with Tianmu to attend the temporary palace at Henei.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, he still crossed the river with Tianmu to attend the temporary palace at Henei.

sentences.zh: 顥平，以本將軍除廣州刺史、假鎮南將軍，轉南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: When Hao was pacified, with his existing rank he was appointed governor of Guang Province and Acting General Who Garrisons the South, then transferred to governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Hao was pacified, with his existing rank he was appointed governor of Guang Province and acting General Who Garrisons the South, then transferred to governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮之死也，顯度情不自安，南奔蕭衍，衍厚待之。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Xiandu could not rest easy and fled south to Xiao Yan, who treated him generously.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Xiandu could not rest easy and fled south to Xiao Yan, who treated him generously.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，還朝，授衞大將軍、儀同三司、左光祿大夫，又行濟州事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai he returned to court and was appointed Grand General of the Guard, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and also acted as governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he returned to court and was appointed Grand General of the Guard, equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and also acted as governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 復隨尒朱度律等北拒義旗，敗於韓陵，與斛斯椿及弟顯智等率眾先據河橋，誅尒朱氏。

translations.literal: He again followed Erzhu Dulu and the others north to resist the righteous banner, was defeated at Hanling, and together with Hu Sichun and his younger brother Xianzhi and the others led troops to seize Heqiao Bridge first and execute the Erzhu clan.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Erzhu Dulu and the others north to resist the righteous banner, was defeated at Hanling, and together with Hu Sichun and his younger brother Xianzhi and the others led troops to seize Heqiao Bridge first and execute the Erzhu clan.

sentences.zh: 出帝初，除尚書左僕射，尋加驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、定州大中正。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Deposed Emperor's reign he was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and soon further made Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and Chief Rectifier of Ding Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Deposed Emperor's reign he was appointed left vice director of the Masters of Writing, and soon further made grand general of agile cavalry, grand commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and chief rectifier of Ding Province.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以本官行徐州刺史、東道大行臺。

translations.literal: Before long, retaining his existing rank, he acted as governor of Xu Province and Grand Commissioner of the Eastern Route.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, retaining his existing rank, he acted as governor of Xu Province and grand commissioner of the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 永熙三年五月，轉雍州刺史、西道大行臺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Yongxi he was transferred to governor of Yong Province and Grand Commissioner of the Western Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of Yongxi he was transferred to governor of Yong Province and grand commissioner of the western route.

sentences.zh: 歿於關中。

translations.literal: He died in the Guanzhong region.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the Guanzhong region.

sentences.zh: 弟智，字顯智，少有膽決。

translations.literal: His younger brother Zhi, courtesy name Xianzhi, from youth had courage and decisiveness.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Zhi, courtesy name Xianzhi, from youth had courage and decisiveness.

sentences.zh: 孝昌中，告毛謐等逆，靈太后嘉之，除伏波將軍、冗從僕射，領直齋。

translations.literal: In the Xiaochang era he reported the treason of Mao Mi and the others; Empress Dowager Ling praised this and appointed him General Who Quells the Waves, Supernumerary Master of Attendants, and Director of the Direct Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiaochang era he reported the treason of Mao Mi and the others; Empress Dowager Ling praised this and appointed him General Who Quells the Waves, supernumerary master of attendants, and director of the direct guard.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍將夏侯夔攻郢州，以智為龍驤將軍、別將討之。

translations.literal: When Xiao Yan's general Xiahou Kui attacked Ying Province, Zhi was made General of Dragon Cavalry and a separate commander to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Yan's general Xiahou Kui attacked Ying Province, Zhi was made General of Dragon Cavalry and a separate commander to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 至則夔退，智仍入城。

translations.literal: When he arrived Kui withdrew, and Zhi still entered the city.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived Kui withdrew, and Zhi still entered the city.

sentences.zh: 及刺史元顯達以城降於蕭衍，[2]智勒城人不欲叛者與顯達交戰，相率歸闕，後為都督，隸太宰、上黨王天穆征邢杲，臨陳流矢中胸，仍戰不已。

translations.literal: When the governor Yuan Xianda surrendered the city to Xiao Yan,[2] Zhi urged those in the city who did not wish to rebel to fight Xianda, and they successively returned to court; later he was made Commander and placed under the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu, in the campaign against Xing Gao; in battle a stray arrow struck his chest, yet he continued fighting.
translations.idiomatic: When the governor Yuan Xianda surrendered the city to Xiao Yan,[2] Zhi urged those in the city who did not wish to rebel to fight Xianda, and they successively returned to court; later he was made commander and placed under the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu, in the campaign against Xing Gao; in battle a stray arrow struck his chest, yet he continued fighting.

sentences.zh: 元顥入洛，仍隨天穆渡河，朝莊帝於河內。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, he still followed Tianmu across the river and attended Emperor Zhuang at Henei.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, he still followed Tianmu across the river and attended Emperor Zhuang at Henei.

sentences.zh: 與尒朱兆同先渡河破顥軍，以勳除持節、征南將軍、金紫光祿大夫，封義陽縣開國伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Together with Erzhu Zhao he was first to cross the river and break Hao's army; for merit he was appointed Bearer of the Staff, General Who Campaigns South, and Grand Master of Golden Splendor and Purple Radiance, and enfeoffed as Baron of Yiyang County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Erzhu Zhao he was first to cross the river and break Hao's army; for merit he was appointed bearer of the staff, General Who Campaigns South, and Grand Master of Golden Splendor and Purple Radiance, and enfeoffed as Baron of Yiyang County with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 假衞將軍，與行臺樊子鵠討呂文欣於東徐州，平之。

translations.literal: Acting General of the Guard, together with the Commissioner Fan Zihu he campaigned against Lü Wenxin in Eastern Xu Province and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Acting General of the Guard, together with Commissioner Fan Zihu he campaigned against Lü Wenxin in Eastern Xu Province and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 加侍中、驃騎大將軍，增邑三百戶。

translations.literal: He was further made Palace Attendant and Grand General of Agile Cavalry, with his fief increased by three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was further made palace attendant and grand general of agile cavalry, with his fief increased by three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 尋行東中郎將，加散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as Eastern Commandant and was further made Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he acted as eastern commandant and was further made regular attendant.

sentences.zh: 及尒朱仲遠為徐州刺史，智隸仲遠，赴彭城。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Zhongyuan became governor of Xu Province, Zhi was placed under Zhongyuan and went to Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Zhongyuan became governor of Xu Province, Zhi was placed under Zhongyuan and went to Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮之死也，仲遠舉兵向洛，智不從之，遂擁部下出清水東，招勒州民，與相拒擊。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Zhongyuan raised troops toward Luoyang; Zhi would not follow and therefore led his subordinates east of the Qingshui River, rallying the people of the province to resist and strike him.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Zhongyuan raised troops toward Luoyang; Zhi would not follow and therefore led his subordinates east of the Qingshui River, rallying the people of the province to resist and strike him.

sentences.zh: 莊帝聞而善之，除右光祿大夫、武衞將軍，進爵為侯，增邑二百戶，通前一千，因鎮徐州。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuang heard of this and approved; Zhi was appointed Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and General of Martial Guard, promoted to Marquis with his fief increased by two hundred households to one thousand in all, and thus garrisoned Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhuang heard of this and approved; Zhi was appointed Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and General of Martial Guard, promoted to marquis with his fief increased by two hundred households to one thousand in all, and thus garrisoned Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，還洛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai he returned to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 仲遠忿其乖背，議欲殺之。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan resented his defection and discussed killing him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan resented his defection and discussed killing him.

sentences.zh: 智兄顯度先為世隆所厚，世隆為解喻得全。

translations.literal: Zhi's elder brother Xiandu had earlier been favored by Shilong, and Shilong explained and persuaded so that he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi's elder brother Xiandu had earlier been favored by Shilong, and Shilong explained and persuaded so that he was spared.

sentences.zh: 時趙脩延起逆荊州，[3]蕭衍遣兵接援，世隆欲令智以功自効，遣智討之，除使持節、散騎常侍、車騎大將軍、左光祿大夫、假驃騎大將軍、荊州大都督，進爵為公。

translations.literal: At that time Zhao Xiuyan rebelled in Jing Province;[3] Xiao Yan sent troops to support him; Shilong wished Zhi to redeem himself by merit and sent him to campaign against Xiuyan, appointing him Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Grand General of Agile Cavalry, and Grand Commander of Jing Province, and promoting him to Duke.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhao Xiuyan rebelled in Jing Province;[3] Xiao Yan sent troops to support him; Shilong wished Zhi to redeem himself by merit and sent him to campaign against Xiuyan, appointing him bearer of the staff, regular attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting grand general of agile cavalry, and grand commander of Jing Province, and promoting him to duke.

sentences.zh: 將發，會荊州斬送脩延首，不行。

translations.literal: Just as he was about to set out, Jing Province sent Xiuyan's head and he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Just as he was about to set out, Jing Province sent Xiuyan's head and he did not go.

sentences.zh: 又從尒朱度律北拒義旗，合尒朱兆於陽平。

translations.literal: He again followed Erzhu Dulu north to resist the righteous banner and joined Erzhu Zhao at Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Erzhu Dulu north to resist the righteous banner and joined Erzhu Zhao at Yangping.

sentences.zh: 兆與度律自相疑阻，退還。

translations.literal: Zhao and Dulu grew suspicious of each other and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao and Dulu grew suspicious of each other and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 除驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand general of agile cavalry.

sentences.zh: 後隨度律等敗於韓陵，智與兄顯度、斛斯椿謀誅尒朱氏。

translations.literal: Later, following Dulu and the others, he was defeated at Hanling; Zhi plotted with his elder brother Xiandu and Hu Sichun to execute the Erzhu clan.
translations.idiomatic: Later, following Dulu and the others, he was defeated at Hanling; Zhi plotted with his elder brother Xiandu and Hu Sichun to execute the Erzhu clan.

sentences.zh: 椿、顯度據守北中，令智等入京，擒世隆兄弟。

translations.literal: Chun and Xiandu held Beizhong Fortress while ordering Zhi and the others to enter the capital and capture the Shilong brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Chun and Xiandu held Beizhong Fortress while ordering Zhi and the others to enter the capital and capture the Shilong brothers.

sentences.zh: 出帝初，除散騎常侍、本將軍、開府儀同三司、滄州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Deposed Emperor's reign he was appointed Regular Attendant, with his existing rank, Grand Commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and governor of Cang Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Deposed Emperor's reign he was appointed regular attendant, with his existing rank, grand commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and governor of Cang Province.

sentences.zh: 在州貪縱，甚為民害，出帝徵還京師。

translations.literal: In the province he was greedy and unrestrained and greatly harmed the people; the Deposed Emperor summoned him back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the province he was greedy and unrestrained and greatly harmed the people; the Deposed Emperor summoned him back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋加授侍中，以本將軍除濟州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was further made Palace Attendant and, with his existing rank, appointed governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was further made palace attendant and, with his existing rank, appointed governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 率眾達東郡，仍停不進，於長壽津為相州刺史竇泰所破，還洛。

translations.literal: He led troops to Dong Commandery but halted and did not advance; at Changshou Ford he was defeated by Dou Tai, governor of Xiang Province, and returned to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops to Dong Commandery but halted and did not advance; at Changshou Ford he was defeated by Dou Tai, governor of Xiang Province, and returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 天平初，赴晉陽。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping he went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping he went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 智去就多端，後坐事死，時年四十五。

translations.literal: Zhi shifted sides repeatedly; later he was executed for an offense, at age forty-five.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi shifted sides repeatedly; later he was executed for an offense, at age forty-five.

sentences.zh: 子羅侯，祕書郎。

translations.literal: His son Luohou was a Secretary Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: His son Luohou was a secretary gentleman.

sentences.zh: 樊子鵠，代郡平城人。

translations.literal: Fan Zihu was a native of Pingcheng in Dai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zihu was a native of Pingcheng in Dai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 其先荊州蠻酋，被遷於代。

translations.literal: His forebears were tribal chiefs of Jing Province who were relocated to Dai.
translations.idiomatic: His forebears were tribal chiefs of Jing Province who were relocated to Dai.

sentences.zh: 父興，平城鎮長史，歸義侯。

translations.literal: His father Xing was Chief Clerk of Pingcheng Garrison and Marquis of Guyi.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xing was chief clerk of Pingcheng Garrison and Marquis of Guyi.

sentences.zh: 普泰中，子鵠貴顯，乃贈征虜將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: In Putai, when Zihu rose to prominence, Xing was posthumously enfeoffed as General Who Conquers the Barbarians and governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In Putai, when Zihu rose to prominence, Xing was posthumously enfeoffed as General Who Conquers the Barbarians and governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 子鵠值北鎮擾亂，南至并州，尒朱榮引為都督府倉曹參軍。

translations.literal: When the northern garrisons were in turmoil, Zihu went south to Bing Province; Erzhu Rong brought him in as Registrar of the Granary in the commandery staff.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern garrisons were in turmoil, Zihu went south to Bing Province; Erzhu Rong brought him in as registrar of the granary in the commandery staff.

sentences.zh: 孝昌三年冬，榮使子鵠詣京師。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year of Xiaochang, Rong sent Zihu to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the third year of Xiaochang, Rong sent Zihu to the capital.

sentences.zh: 靈太后見之，問榮兵勢，子鵠應對稱旨，太后嘉之。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling received him and asked about Rong's military strength; Zihu answered to her satisfaction and the empress dowager praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling received him and asked about Rong's military strength; Zihu answered to her satisfaction and the empress dowager praised him.

sentences.zh: 除直齋，封南和縣開國子，邑三百戶，令還赴榮。

translations.literal: He was appointed to the Direct Guard, enfeoffed as Viscount of Nanhe County with a fief of three hundred households, and ordered to return to Rong.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed to the direct guard, enfeoffed as viscount of Nanhe County with a fief of three hundred households, and ordered to return to Rong.

sentences.zh: 榮以為行臺郎中，行上黨郡。

translations.literal: Rong made him Gentleman of the Forward Office and acting Administrator of Shangdang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Rong made him gentleman of the forward office and acting administrator of Shangdang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 及榮向洛，以為假節、假平南將軍、都督河東正平軍事、行唐州事。

translations.literal: When Rong marched on Luoyang, Zihu was made Acting Bearer of the Staff, Acting General Who Pacifies the South, Commander of the Military Affairs of Hedong and Zhengping, and Acting Administrator of Tang Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong marched on Luoyang, Zihu was made acting bearer of the staff, acting General Who Pacifies the South, commander of the military affairs of Hedong and Zhengping, and acting administrator of Tang Province.

sentences.zh: 刺史崔元珍閉門拒守，子鵠攻克之。

translations.literal: The governor Cui Yuanzhen closed the gates and resisted; Zihu captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: The governor Cui Yuanzhen closed the gates and resisted; Zihu captured the city.

sentences.zh: 建義初，拜平北將軍、晉州刺史，封永安縣開國伯，食邑千戶，又兼尚書行臺。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi he was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and governor of Jin Province, enfeoffed as Baron of Yong'an County with a fief of one thousand households, and also made Concurrent Commissioner of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Jianyi he was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and governor of Jin Province, enfeoffed as baron of Yong'an County with a fief of one thousand households, and also made concurrent commissioner of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 治有威信，山胡率服。

translations.literal: His governance had authority and trust, and the mountain tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: His governance had authority and trust, and the mountain tribes submitted.

sentences.zh: 元顥入洛，薛脩義及降蜀陳雙熾等受顥處分，率眾攻州城。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Xue Xiuyi and the surrendered Shu Chen Shuangchi and others, acting under Hao's orders, led troops to attack the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Xue Xiuyi and the surrendered Shu Chen Shuangchi and others, acting under Hao's orders, led troops to attack the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 子鵠出與戰，大破之，又破脩義等於土門。

translations.literal: Zihu went out to fight, routed them greatly, and again defeated Xiuyi and the others at Tumen.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu went out to fight, routed them greatly, and again defeated Xiuyi and the others at Tumen.

sentences.zh: 以功拜撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: For merit he was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 尋徵授都官尚書、西荊州大中正。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned and appointed Minister of Justice and Chief Rectifier of Western Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was summoned and appointed minister of justice and chief rectifier of Western Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 後兼右僕射，為行臺，督賈智等討呂文欣於東徐州，平之。

translations.literal: Later he was made Concurrent Right Vice Director and Commissioner, supervising Jia Zhi and the others in campaigning against Lü Wenxin in Eastern Xu Province, and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was made concurrent right vice director and commissioner, supervising Jia Zhi and the others in campaigning against Lü Wenxin in Eastern Xu Province, and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 還，除車騎將軍、左光祿大夫，進封南陽郡開國公，增戶六百，尚書如故，仍假驃騎大將軍，率所部為都督。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, promoted to Duke of Nanyang Commandery with six hundred additional households, retaining his ministerial post, and still made Acting Grand General of Agile Cavalry, leading his command as Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, promoted to Duke of Nanyang Commandery with six hundred additional households, retaining his ministerial post, and still made acting grand general of agile cavalry, leading his command as commander.

sentences.zh: 時尒朱榮在晉陽，京師之事，子鵠頗預委寄，故在臺閣，征官不解。

translations.literal: At that time Erzhu Rong was at Jinyang; in the affairs of the capital Zihu was much entrusted, and therefore while at court his summons to office was not released.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Erzhu Rong was at Jinyang; in the affairs of the capital Zihu was much entrusted, and therefore while at court his summons to office was not released.

sentences.zh: 後出除散騎常侍、本將軍、殷州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he was sent out and appointed Regular Attendant, with his existing rank, and governor of Yin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was sent out and appointed regular attendant, with his existing rank, and governor of Yin Province.

sentences.zh: 屬歲旱儉，子鵠恐民流亡，乃勒有粟之家分貸貧者，并遣人牛易力，多種二麥，州內以此獲安。

translations.literal: There was drought and famine that year; Zihu feared the people would flee, and therefore ordered households with grain to lend to the poor, also sending men and oxen to exchange labor and planting much winter wheat, so that within the province peace was thereby secured.
translations.idiomatic: There was drought and famine that year; Zihu feared the people would flee, and therefore ordered households with grain to lend to the poor, also sending men and oxen to exchange labor and planting much winter wheat, so that within the province peace was thereby secured.

sentences.zh: 及尒朱榮之死，世隆等遣書招子鵠，欲與同趣京師，子鵠不從。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Shilong and the others sent letters summoning Zihu, wishing to go together to the capital; Zihu would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Shilong and the others sent letters summoning Zihu, wishing to go together to the capital; Zihu would not follow.

sentences.zh: 以母在晉陽，啟求移鎮河南。

translations.literal: Because his mother was at Jinyang, he memorialized asking to transfer his garrison south of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Because his mother was at Jinyang, he memorialized asking to transfer his garrison south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 莊帝嘉之，除車騎大將軍、豫州刺史、假驃騎大將軍、都督二豫郢三州諸軍事、兼尚書右僕射、二豫郢潁四州行臺。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuang approved; Zihu was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, governor of Yu Province, Acting Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of the two Yu, Ying, and three provinces, Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Commissioner of the Route for the four provinces of the two Yu, Ying, and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhuang approved; Zihu was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, governor of Yu Province, acting grand general of agile cavalry, commander-in-chief over the military affairs of the two Yu, Ying, and three provinces, concurrent right vice director of the Masters of Writing, and commissioner of the route for the four provinces of the two Yu, Ying, and Ying.

sentences.zh: 子鵠到相州，又敕賚絹五百匹。

translations.literal: When Zihu reached Xiang Province, an edict also bestowed five hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: When Zihu reached Xiang Province, an edict also bestowed five hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 行達汲郡，聞尒朱兆入洛，乃渡河見仲遠，仲遠遣鎮汲郡。

translations.literal: When he reached Ji Commandery on the road he heard that Erzhu Zhao had entered Luoyang; he then crossed the river to see Zhongyuan, and Zhongyuan sent him to garrison Ji Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Ji Commandery on the road he heard that Erzhu Zhao had entered Luoyang; he then crossed the river to see Zhongyuan, and Zhongyuan sent him to garrison Ji Commandery.

sentences.zh: 兆徵子鵠赴洛，既見，責以乖異之意，奪其部眾，將還晉陽。

translations.literal: Zhao summoned Zihu to Luoyang; after meeting him he rebuked him for disloyalty, stripped him of his troops, and was about to return to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao summoned Zihu to Luoyang; after meeting him he rebuked him for disloyalty, stripped him of his troops, and was about to return to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 及紇豆陵步藩起，以子鵠為都督，徵發糧仗。

translations.literal: When Gedouling Bufan rose in rebellion, Zihu was made Commander to levy grain and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: When Gedouling Bufan rose in rebellion, Zihu was made commander to levy grain and weapons.

sentences.zh: 元曄以為侍中、御史中尉、中軍大都督，隨曄向洛。

translations.literal: Yuan Ye made him Palace Attendant, Imperial Censor, and Grand Commander of the Central Army, and he followed Ye toward Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Ye made him palace attendant, imperial censor, and grand commander of the central army, and he followed Ye toward Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，仍除舊任。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai he was still appointed to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he was still appointed to his former post.

sentences.zh: 及趙脩延叛於荊州，詔子鵠通三鵶道而還。

translations.literal: When Zhao Xiuyan rebelled in Jing Province, an edict ordered Zihu to return by the Three E'ya Road.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Xiuyan rebelled in Jing Province, an edict ordered Zihu to return by the Three E'ya Road.

sentences.zh: 遭母憂去職，前廢帝聞其在洛無宅，凶費不周，賚絹四百匹、粟五百石，以本官起之。

translations.literal: Upon entering mourning for his mother he left office; the deposed emperor heard he had no house in Luoyang and insufficient funds for the funeral, and bestowed four hundred bolts of silk and five hundred shi of grain, recalling him to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Upon entering mourning for his mother he left office; the deposed emperor heard he had no house in Luoyang and insufficient funds for the funeral, and bestowed four hundred bolts of silk and five hundred shi of grain, recalling him to his former post.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，兼尚書左僕射、東南道大行臺，總大都督杜德等追討尒朱仲遠。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang he was made Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Commissioner of the Southeastern Route, commanding the Grand Commander Du De and the others in pursuing Erzhu Zhongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang he was made concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing and grand commissioner of the southeastern route, commanding Grand Commander Du De and the others in pursuing Erzhu Zhongyuan.

sentences.zh: 仲遠已奔蕭衍，收其兵馬甲仗。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan had already fled to Xiao Yan; they collected his troops, horses, armor, and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan had already fled to Xiao Yan; they collected his troops, horses, armor, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 時蕭衍遣元樹入寇，陷據譙城。

translations.literal: At that time Xiao Yan sent Yuan Shu to invade, who captured and held Qiao city.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiao Yan sent Yuan Shu to invade, who captured and held Qiao city.

sentences.zh: 詔子鵠與德討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zihu and De to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zihu and De to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 樹屯兵梁國，欲來逆戰，見子鵠軍盛，夜退還譙。

translations.literal: Shu encamped at Liang State and wished to come out and meet them in battle, but seeing Zihu's army was strong he withdrew by night to Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: Shu encamped at Liang State and wished to come out and meet them in battle, but seeing Zihu's army was strong he withdrew by night to Qiao.

sentences.zh: 子鵠引兵追躡，樹又背城為陳。

translations.literal: Zihu led troops in pursuit; Shu again formed battle lines with his back to the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu led troops in pursuit; Shu again formed battle lines with his back to the city.

sentences.zh: 子鵠勒兵直趣城下，縱騎衝突，樹眾大敗，奔入城門，城門隘塞，多自殺害。

translations.literal: Zihu drove his troops straight to the foot of the wall and unleashed cavalry in charge; Shu's force was routed greatly, fled into the gate, and the gate was jammed so that many killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu drove his troops straight to the foot of the wall and unleashed cavalry in charge; Shu's force was routed greatly, fled into the gate, and the gate was jammed so that many killed themselves.

sentences.zh: 於是斬千餘級，獲馬數百匹，大收鎧仗，遂圍城。

translations.literal: Thereupon more than a thousand were beheaded, several hundred horses were captured, much armor and weapons were collected, and they then besieged the city.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon more than a thousand were beheaded, several hundred horses were captured, much armor and weapons were collected, and they then besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 加儀同三司。

translations.literal: He was further made Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: He was further made equal in honor to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 樹勒兵出戰，輒被摧衄，遂不敢出，自守而已。

translations.literal: Shu led troops out to fight but was repeatedly crushed and then dared not come out, merely holding the city.
translations.idiomatic: Shu led troops out to fight but was repeatedly crushed and then dared not come out, merely holding the city.

sentences.zh: 子鵠恐蕭衍遣救，乃分兵擊衍苞州、然州、宕州、大澗、蒙縣等五城，並望風逃散。

translations.literal: Zihu feared Xiao Yan would send relief and therefore divided troops to attack Yan's five cities of Bao, Ran, Dang, Dajian, and Meng, all of which fled at the news.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu feared Xiao Yan would send relief and therefore divided troops to attack Yan's five cities of Bao, Ran, Dang, Dajian, and Meng, all of which fled at the news.

sentences.zh: 樹既無外援，計無所出，子鵠又令人說之，樹遂請率眾歸南，以地還國。

translations.literal: Shu, having no external aid and no plan left, was again persuaded by men Zihu sent; Shu then asked to lead his people south and return the territory to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Shu, having no external aid and no plan left, was again persuaded by men Zihu sent; Shu then asked to lead his people south and return the territory to the state.

sentences.zh: 子鵠等許之，共結盟約。

translations.literal: Zihu and the others agreed and together made a covenant.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu and the others agreed and together made a covenant.

sentences.zh: 及樹眾半出，子鵠中擊，破之，擒樹及衍譙州刺史朱文開，俘馘甚多。

translations.literal: When half of Shu's force had come out, Zihu struck them in the middle, broke them, and captured Shu and Yan's governor of Qiao Province Zhu Wenkai, taking many captives and heads.
translations.idiomatic: When half of Shu's force had come out, Zihu struck them in the middle, broke them, and captured Shu and Yan's governor of Qiao Province Zhu Wenkai, taking many captives and heads.

sentences.zh: 班師，出帝賚馬匹。

translations.literal: On returning from the campaign the Deposed Emperor bestowed horses.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from the campaign the Deposed Emperor bestowed horses.

sentences.zh: 遷吏部尚書，轉尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and then to Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to minister of the Ministry of Personnel and then to right vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 尋加驃騎大將軍、開府，典選。

translations.literal: Soon he was further made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Grand Commander, and supervised appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was further made grand general of agile cavalry and grand commander, and supervised appointments.

sentences.zh: 初，青州人耿翔聚眾反，亡奔蕭衍，衍資其兵，偷據膠州。

translations.literal: Earlier, Geng Xiang of Qing Province gathered a crowd in rebellion, fled to Xiao Yan, and Yan supplied him with troops; he stealthily seized Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Geng Xiang of Qing Province gathered a crowd in rebellion, fled to Xiao Yan, and Yan supplied him with troops; he stealthily seized Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 除子鵠使持節、侍中、青膠大使，督濟州刺史蔡雋討之。

translations.literal: Zihu was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Palace Attendant, and Commissioner for Qing and Jiao, supervising Cai Jun, governor of Ji Province, to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu was appointed bearer of the staff, palace attendant, and commissioner for Qing and Jiao, supervising Cai Jun, governor of Ji Province, to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 師達青州，翔拔城奔走。
