translations.literal: When the army reached Qing Province, Xiang abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Qing Province, Xiang abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 在軍遇病，詔遣醫給藥。

translations.literal: While in the army he fell ill; an edict sent physicians with medicine.
translations.idiomatic: While in the army he fell ill; an edict sent physicians with medicine.

sentences.zh: 仍除兗州刺史，餘官如故，便道之州。

translations.literal: He was still appointed governor of Yan Province, with the rest unchanged, and went directly to the province.
translations.idiomatic: He was still appointed governor of Yan Province, with the rest unchanged, and went directly to the province.

sentences.zh: 子鵠先遣腹心緣歷民間，採察得失。

translations.literal: Zihu first sent trusted men to travel through the countryside investigating gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu first sent trusted men to travel through the countryside investigating gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 及入境，太山太守彭穆參候失儀，子鵠責讓穆，并數其罪狀，穆皆引伏，於是州內震悚。

translations.literal: When he entered the province, the Administrator of Mount Tai, Peng Mu, paid his respects with improper ceremony; Zihu rebuked Mu and enumerated his offenses, and Mu confessed to all, whereupon the province was shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: When he entered the province, the administrator of Mount Tai, Peng Mu, paid his respects with improper ceremony; Zihu rebuked Mu and enumerated his offenses, and Mu confessed to all, whereupon the province was shaken with fear.

sentences.zh: 及出帝入關，子鵠據城為逆。

translations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor entered the passes, Zihu held the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor entered the passes, Zihu held the city in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 南青州刺史大野拔、徐州人劉粹各率眾就子鵠。

translations.literal: Daye Ba, governor of Southern Qing Province, and Liu Cui of Xu Province each led troops to join Zihu.
translations.idiomatic: Daye Ba, governor of Southern Qing Province, and Liu Cui of Xu Province each led troops to join Zihu.

sentences.zh: 天平初，遣儀同三司婁昭等率眾討之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping troops were sent under Lou Zhao and others to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping troops were sent under Lou Zhao and others to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 子鵠先使前膠州刺史嚴思達鎮東平郡，昭攻陷之，仍引兵圍子鵠。

translations.literal: Zihu first sent the former governor of Jiao Province Yan Sida to garrison Dongping Commandery; Zhao captured it and then led troops to besiege Zihu.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu first sent the former governor of Jiao Province Yan Sida to garrison Dongping Commandery; Zhao captured it and then led troops to besiege Zihu.

sentences.zh: 城久不拔，昭以水灌城。

translations.literal: The city long could not be taken; Zhao flooded it with water.
translations.idiomatic: The city long could not be taken; Zhao flooded it with water.

sentences.zh: 靜帝欲招慰下之，遣散騎常侍陸琛、兼黃門郎張景徵齎璽書勞子鵠，而大野拔因與相見，左右斬子鵠以降。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing wished to win him over and sent Regular Attendant Lu Chen and Concurrent Gentleman at the Yellow Gate Zhang Jingzheng bearing the imperial seal to console Zihu, but Daye Ba took advantage of the meeting and his attendants beheaded Zihu to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing wished to win him over and sent Regular Attendant Lu Chen and concurrent gentleman at the Yellow Gate Zhang Jingzheng bearing the imperial seal to console Zihu, but Daye Ba took advantage of the meeting and his attendants beheaded Zihu to surrender.

sentences.zh: 賀拔勝，字破胡，神武尖山人。

translations.literal: He Basheng, courtesy name Pohu, was a native of Shenwu Jianshan.
translations.idiomatic: He Basheng, courtesy name Pohu, was a native of Shenwu Jianshan.

sentences.zh: 祖爾逗，選充北防，家於武川。

translations.literal: His grandfather Erdou was selected for northern frontier defense and settled his family at Wuchuan.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Erdou was selected for northern frontier defense and settled his family at Wuchuan.

sentences.zh: 以窺覘蠕蠕，兼有戰功，顯祖賜爵龍城男，為本鎮軍主。

translations.literal: For reconnoitering the Rouran and also having battle merit, Emperor Xianzu granted him the title Baron of Longcheng and made him garrison commander of the local fort.
translations.idiomatic: For reconnoitering the Rouran and also having battle merit, Emperor Xianzu granted him the title Baron of Longcheng and made him garrison commander of the local fort.

sentences.zh: 父度拔，襲爵。

translations.literal: His father Dubo inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His father Dubo inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 正光末，沃野人破落汗拔陵聚眾反，度拔與三子、鄉中豪勇援懷朔鎮，殺賊王衞可瓌。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenguang the Woye man Poluohan Baling gathered a crowd in rebellion; Dubo, with his three sons and bold men of the district, went to relieve Huaishuo Garrison and killed the bandit king Wei Ke'gui.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenguang the Woye man Poluohan Baling gathered a crowd in rebellion; Dubo, with his three sons and bold men of the district, went to relieve Huaishuo Garrison and killed the bandit king Wei Ke'gui.

sentences.zh: 度拔尋為賊所害，孝昌中，追贈安遠將軍、肆州刺史。

translations.literal: Dubo was soon killed by bandits; in the Xiaochang era he was posthumously enfeoffed as General of Pacifying the Distance and governor of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: Dubo was soon killed by bandits; in the Xiaochang era he was posthumously enfeoffed as General of Pacifying the Distance and governor of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 度拔之死也，勝與兄弟俱奔恒州刺史廣陽王淵。

translations.literal: When Dubo died, Sheng fled with his brothers to Prince of Guangyang Yuan, governor of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Dubo died, Sheng fled with his brothers to Prince of Guangyang Yuan, governor of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 勝便弓馬，有武幹，淵厚待之，表為強弩將軍，充帳內軍主。

translations.literal: Sheng was skilled with bow and horse and had martial talent; Yuan treated him generously, memorialized him as General of Strong Crossbows, and made him commander of the inner guard.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was skilled with bow and horse and had martial talent; Yuan treated him generously, memorialized him as General of Strong Crossbows, and made him commander of the inner guard.

sentences.zh: 恒州陷，歸尒朱榮，轉積射將軍，為別將，又兼都督。

translations.literal: When Heng Province fell he joined Erzhu Rong, was transferred to General of Accumulated Shots, made a separate commander, and also made Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Heng Province fell he joined Erzhu Rong, was transferred to General of Accumulated Shots, made a separate commander, and also made commander.

sentences.zh: 及榮入洛，以預義之勳，封易陽縣開國伯，邑四百戶，除直閤將軍，尋加通直散騎常侍、平南將軍、光祿大夫，進號安南將軍。

translations.literal: When Rong entered Luoyang, for participating in the righteous enterprise he was enfeoffed as Baron of Yiyang County with a fief of four hundred households, appointed General of the Direct Gate, and soon further made Unqualified Regular Attendant, General Who Pacifies the South, and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, with his title advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong entered Luoyang, for participating in the righteous enterprise he was enfeoffed as Baron of Yiyang County with a fief of four hundred households, appointed General of the Direct Gate, and soon further made unqualified regular attendant, General Who Pacifies the South, and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, with his title advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 尋除撫軍將軍，為大都督，出井陘，鎮中山。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, made Grand Commander, went out through Jingxing Pass, and garrisoned Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, made grand commander, went out through Jingxing Pass, and garrisoned Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 元顥入洛，勝從東路率騎三百赴行宮於河梁。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Sheng took the eastern route and led three hundred horsemen to the temporary palace at Heqiao.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Sheng took the eastern route and led three hundred horsemen to the temporary palace at Heqiao.

sentences.zh: 榮命勝與尒朱兆先渡，破擒顥息冠受及顥大都督陳思保。

translations.literal: Rong ordered Sheng and Erzhu Zhao to cross first, broke Hao's force, and captured Hao's son Guanshou and Hao's Grand Commander Chen Sibao.
translations.idiomatic: Rong ordered Sheng and Erzhu Zhao to cross first, broke Hao's force, and captured Hao's son Guanshou and Hao's grand commander Chen Sibao.

sentences.zh: 莊帝還宮，以功增邑六百戶，復加通直散騎常侍、征北將軍、金紫光祿大夫、武衞將軍，改封真定縣開國公。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang returned to the palace, for merit his fief was increased by six hundred households; he was again made Unqualified Regular Attendant, General Who Campaigns North, Grand Master of Golden Splendor and Purple Radiance, and General of Martial Guard, with his title changed to Duke of Zhending County.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang returned to the palace, for merit his fief was increased by six hundred households; he was again made unqualified regular attendant, General Who Campaigns North, Grand Master of Golden Splendor and Purple Radiance, and General of Martial Guard, with his title changed to Duke of Zhending County.

sentences.zh: 尋除衞將軍，加散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed General of the Guard and further made Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed General of the Guard and further made regular attendant.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮之死也，勝與田怙等奔走榮第。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Sheng ran with Tian Hu and the others to Rong's residence.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Sheng ran with Tian Hu and the others to Rong's residence.

sentences.zh: 於時宮殿之門未加嚴防，怙等議即攻門。

translations.literal: At that time the palace gates were not yet strictly guarded; Hu and the others discussed attacking the gates at once.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the palace gates were not yet strictly guarded; Hu and the others discussed attacking the gates at once.

sentences.zh: 勝止之曰：「天子既行大事，必當更有奇謀，吾等眾旅不多，何可輕爾，但得出城，更為他計。

translations.literal: Sheng stopped them, saying, "The Son of Heaven has already undertaken a great act; there must be some further stratagem. Our force is not large—how can we act rashly? We need only get out of the city and devise another plan.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng stopped them, saying, "The Son of Heaven has already undertaken a great act; there must be some further stratagem. Our force is not large—how can we act rashly? We need only get out of the city and devise another plan.

sentences.zh: 」怙乃止。

translations.literal: " Hu then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " Hu then stopped.

sentences.zh: 及世隆夜走，勝遂不從，莊帝甚嘉之。

translations.literal: When Shilong fled by night, Sheng would not follow; Emperor Zhuang greatly approved.
translations.idiomatic: When Shilong fled by night, Sheng would not follow; Emperor Zhuang greatly approved.

sentences.zh: 仲遠逼東郡，詔勝以本官假驃騎大將軍為東征都督，率眾會鄭先護以討之。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan pressed Dong Commandery; an edict made Sheng, with his existing rank, Acting Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Eastern Campaign Commander, leading troops to join Zheng Xianhu in campaigning against him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan pressed Dong Commandery; an edict made Sheng, with his existing rank, acting grand general of agile cavalry and eastern campaign commander, leading troops to join Zheng Xianhu in campaigning against him.

sentences.zh: 為先護所疑，置之營外，人馬未得休息。

translations.literal: Xianhu suspected him and placed him outside the camp; men and horses got no rest.
translations.idiomatic: Xianhu suspected him and placed him outside the camp; men and horses got no rest.

sentences.zh: 俄而仲遠兵至，勝與交戰不利，乃降之。

translations.literal: Soon Zhongyuan's troops arrived; Sheng fought unfavorably and then surrendered to him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zhongyuan's troops arrived; Sheng fought unfavorably and then surrendered to him.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，除右衞將軍，進號車騎大將軍、右光祿大夫、儀同三司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai he was appointed General of the Right Guard, with his title advanced to General of Chariots and Cavalry, Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he was appointed General of the Right Guard, with his title advanced to General of Chariots and Cavalry, Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and equal in honor to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 共尒朱仲遠、度律北拒義旗，相與奔退。

translations.literal: Together with Erzhu Zhongyuan and Dulu he went north to resist the righteous banner and fled together.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Erzhu Zhongyuan and Dulu he went north to resist the righteous banner and fled together.

sentences.zh: 事在尒朱兆傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in Erzhu Zhao's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The account is given in Erzhu Zhao's biography.

sentences.zh: 後俱敗於韓陵，勝因降齊獻武王。

translations.literal: Later they were all defeated at Hanling, and Sheng therefore surrendered to King Xianwu of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Later they were all defeated at Hanling, and Sheng therefore surrendered to King Xianwu of Qi.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，拜領軍將軍，餘官如故，又除侍中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang he was appointed General of the Garrison Army, with the rest unchanged, and also made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang he was appointed General of the Garrison Army, with the rest unchanged, and also made palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 出帝既納斛斯椿等讒間之說，將謀齊獻武王，以勝弟岳擁眾關西，仍欲廣為勢援，除勝使持節、侍中、都督三荊二郢南襄南雍七州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor, having accepted the slander and discord of Hu Sichun and the others, planned against King Xianwu of Qi; because Sheng's younger brother He Bayue held troops in the Guanzhong region and he still wished to broaden his support, Sheng was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Palace Attendant, Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of the seven provinces of the three Jing, two Ying, Southern Xiang, and Southern Yong, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor, having accepted the slander and discord of Hu Sichun and the others, planned against King Xianwu of Qi; because Sheng's younger brother He Bayue held troops in the Guanzhong region and he still wished to broaden his support, Sheng was appointed bearer of the staff, palace attendant, commander-in-chief over the military affairs of the seven provinces of the three Jing, two Ying, Southern Xiang, and Southern Yong, grand general of agile cavalry, grand commander with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, and governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 勝將圖襄陽，攻蕭衍下迮戍，克之，擒其戍主尹道玩、戍副庫峩。

translations.literal: Sheng planned to take Xiangyang, attacked Xiao Yan's lower Zha garrison, captured it, and seized its garrison commander Yin Daowan and deputy Ku E.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng planned to take Xiangyang, attacked Xiao Yan's lower Zha garrison, captured it, and seized its garrison commander Yin Daowan and deputy Ku E.

sentences.zh: 又使人誘動蠻王問道期，道期率種起義。

translations.literal: He also sent men to entice and stir up the tribal king Wendaoqi, and Wendaoqi led his people in righteous uprising.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent men to entice and stir up the tribal king Wendaoqi, and Wendaoqi led his people in righteous uprising.

sentences.zh: 衍雍州刺史蕭續遣軍擊道期，為道期所敗，漢南大駭。

translations.literal: Yan's governor of Yong Province, Xiao Xu, sent troops to attack Wendaoqi and was defeated by Wendaoqi; south of the Han there was great alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's governor of Yong Province, Xiao Xu, sent troops to attack Wendaoqi and was defeated by Wendaoqi; south of the Han there was great alarm.

sentences.zh: 勝又遣軍攻均口，擒衍將莊思延，又攻馮翊、安定、沔陽、酇陽城，並平之。

translations.literal: Sheng again sent troops to attack Junkou, captured Yan's general Zhuang Siyan, and also attacked the cities of Fengyi, Anding, Mianyang, and Zunyang, pacifying them all.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng again sent troops to attack Junkou, captured Yan's general Zhuang Siyan, and also attacked the cities of Fengyi, Anding, Mianyang, and Zunyang, pacifying them all.

sentences.zh: [4]續遣將柳仲禮於穀城拒守，勝攻之不克，乃班師。

translations.literal: [4] Xu sent the general Liu Zhongli to hold Gucheng in defense; Sheng attacked but could not take it and then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: [4] Xu sent the general Liu Zhongli to hold Gucheng in defense; Sheng attacked but could not take it and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 沔北盪為丘墟矣。

translations.literal: North of the Mian was laid waste to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Mian was laid waste to ruin.

sentences.zh: 衍書敕續云：「賀拔勝北間驍將，汝宜慎之，勿與爭鋒。

translations.literal: Yan wrote instructing Xu, saying, "He Basheng is a fierce general of the northern lands; you should be cautious and not contend with him.
translations.idiomatic: Yan wrote instructing Xu, saying, "He Basheng is a fierce general of the northern lands; you should be cautious and not contend with him.

sentences.zh: 」其見憚如此。

translations.literal: " Such was the fear he inspired.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was the fear he inspired.

sentences.zh: 進爵琅邪郡公。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Duke of Langye Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Duke of Langye Commandery.

sentences.zh: 出帝末，詔勝統眾北赴京師。

translations.literal: At the end of the Deposed Emperor's reign an edict ordered Sheng to command troops north to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Deposed Emperor's reign an edict ordered Sheng to command troops north to the capital.

sentences.zh: 軍次汝水，出帝入關。

translations.literal: The army halted at the Ru River; the Deposed Emperor entered the passes.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at the Ru River; the Deposed Emperor entered the passes.

sentences.zh: 勝率所部欲從武關趣長安。

translations.literal: Sheng led his command wishing to go from Wuguan Pass toward Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng led his command wishing to go from Wuguan Pass toward Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 行至析陽，聞齊獻武王平潼關，擒毛鴻賓，勝懼，復走荊州，城人閉門不納。

translations.literal: When he reached Xiyang he heard that King Xianwu of Qi had pacified Tong Pass and captured Mao Hongbin; Sheng was afraid and fled again to Jing Province, but the city people closed the gates and would not admit him.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Xiyang he heard that King Xianwu of Qi had pacified Tong Pass and captured Mao Hongbin; Sheng was afraid and fled again to Jing Province, but the city people closed the gates and would not admit him.

sentences.zh: 時獻武王已遣行臺侯景、大都督高敖曹討之，勝戰敗，為流矢所中，乃率左右五百餘騎奔蕭衍。

translations.literal: At that time King Xianwu had already sent Commissioner Hou Jing and Grand Commander Gao Aocao to campaign against him; Sheng was defeated in battle, struck by a stray arrow, and then led more than five hundred horsemen of his personal guard to flee to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time King Xianwu had already sent Commissioner Hou Jing and Grand Commander Gao Aocao to campaign against him; Sheng was defeated in battle, struck by a stray arrow, and then led more than five hundred horsemen of his personal guard to flee to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 明年，從間道投寶炬。

translations.literal: The next year he went by a hidden route to join Bao Ju.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he went by a hidden route to join Bao Ju.

sentences.zh: 勝好行小數，志大膽薄，周章南北，終無所成，致歿於賊中。

translations.literal: Sheng liked petty stratagems, had great ambition but little courage, wavered between north and south, ultimately achieved nothing, and ended dying among the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng liked petty stratagems, had great ambition but little courage, wavered between north and south, ultimately achieved nothing, and ended dying among the enemy.

sentences.zh: 勝兄可泥，永熙中，太尉公，封燕郡王。

translations.literal: Sheng's elder brother Kerni, in the Yongxi era, was Duke of Grand Commandant and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng's elder brother Kerni, in the Yongxi era, was Duke of Grand Commandant and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 勝弟岳，字阿斗泥。

translations.literal: Sheng's younger brother Yue, courtesy name Adouni.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng's younger brother Yue, courtesy name Adouni.

sentences.zh: 初為太學生，長以弓馬為事。

translations.literal: At first he was a student at the Imperial Academy; as he grew he devoted himself to bow and horse.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was a student at the Imperial Academy; as he grew he devoted himself to bow and horse.

sentences.zh: 與父兄赴援懷朔，賊王衞可瓌在城西二百餘步，岳乘城射之，箭中瓌臂，賊眾大駭。

translations.literal: Going with his father and elder brothers to relieve Huaishuo, the bandit king Wei Ke'gui was more than two hundred paces west of the city; Yue mounted the wall and shot him, the arrow striking Ke'gui's arm, and the bandit force was greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Going with his father and elder brothers to relieve Huaishuo, the bandit king Wei Ke'gui was more than two hundred paces west of the city; Yue mounted the wall and shot him, the arrow striking Ke'gui's arm, and the bandit force was greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 後歸恒州，廣陽王淵以為帳內軍主，表為強弩將軍。

translations.literal: Later he returned to Heng Province; Prince of Guangyang Yuan made him commander of the inner guard and memorialized him as General of Strong Crossbows.
translations.idiomatic: Later he returned to Heng Province; Prince of Guangyang Yuan made him commander of the inner guard and memorialized him as General of Strong Crossbows.

sentences.zh: 州陷，投尒朱榮，榮以為別將，進為都督。

translations.literal: When the province fell he joined Erzhu Rong; Rong made him a separate commander and promoted him to Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the province fell he joined Erzhu Rong; Rong made him a separate commander and promoted him to commander.

sentences.zh: 永安初，除安北將軍、光祿大夫、武衞將軍，賜爵樊城鄉男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yong'an he was appointed General Who Pacifies the North, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and General of Martial Guard, and granted the title Viscount of Fancheng Township.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yong'an he was appointed General Who Pacifies the North, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and General of Martial Guard, and granted the title Viscount of Fancheng Township.

sentences.zh: 坐事失官爵，二年，詔並復之。

translations.literal: For an offense he lost office and title; in the second year an edict restored both.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense he lost office and title; in the second year an edict restored both.

sentences.zh: 尋除使持節、假衞將軍、西道都督，隸尒朱天光為左廂大都督，討万俟醜奴。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Acting General of the Guard, and Commander of the Western Route, placed under Erzhu Tianguang as Grand Commander of the Left Wing to campaign against Wanqi Chounu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed bearer of the staff, acting General of the Guard, and commander of the western route, placed under Erzhu Tianguang as grand commander of the left wing to campaign against Wanqi Chounu.

sentences.zh: 天光先知岳，喜得同行，每事論訪。

translations.literal: Tianguang had known Yue earlier and was pleased to travel together, consulting him on every matter.
translations.idiomatic: Tianguang had known Yue earlier and was pleased to travel together, consulting him on every matter.

sentences.zh: 尋加衞將軍、假車騎將軍，餘如故。

translations.literal: Soon he was further made General of the Guard and Acting General of Chariots and Cavalry, with the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was further made General of the Guard and acting General of Chariots and Cavalry, with the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 岳屆長安，榮遣兵續至。

translations.literal: When Yue reached Chang'an, Rong sent troops to follow.
translations.idiomatic: When Yue reached Chang'an, Rong sent troops to follow.

sentences.zh: [5]時万俟醜奴遣其大行臺尉遲菩薩向武功，南渡渭水，攻圍趣柵。

translations.literal: [5] At that time Wanqi Chounu sent his Grand Forward Commissioner Yuchi Pusa toward Wugong; he crossed the Wei River southward and besieged the Qu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: [5] At that time Wanqi Chounu sent his grand forward commissioner Yuchi Pusa toward Wugong; he crossed the Wei River southward and besieged the Qu stockade.

sentences.zh: 天光遣岳率騎一千馳往赴救，菩薩攻柵已克，還向岐州。

translations.literal: Tianguang sent Yue to lead one thousand horsemen in haste to the rescue; Pusa had already taken the stockade and was returning toward Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Tianguang sent Yue to lead one thousand horsemen in haste to the rescue; Pusa had already taken the stockade and was returning toward Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 岳以輕騎八百北渡渭水擒賊，令殺掠其民，以挑菩薩。

translations.literal: Yue with eight hundred light horsemen crossed the Wei River northward, captured bandits, and ordered them to kill and plunder the people to provoke Pusa.
translations.idiomatic: Yue with eight hundred light horsemen crossed the Wei River northward, captured bandits, and ordered them to kill and plunder the people to provoke Pusa.

sentences.zh: 菩薩果率步騎二萬餘人至渭水北。

translations.literal: Pusa indeed led more than twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to the north bank of the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Pusa indeed led more than twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to the north bank of the Wei.

sentences.zh: 岳以輕騎數十與菩薩隔水交言，岳稱揚國威，菩薩自言強盛，往復數返。

translations.literal: Yue with several dozen light horsemen spoke with Pusa across the water; Yue proclaimed the state's might and Pusa proclaimed his own strength, back and forth several times.
translations.idiomatic: Yue with several dozen light horsemen spoke with Pusa across the water; Yue proclaimed the state's might and Pusa proclaimed his own strength, back and forth several times.

sentences.zh: 菩薩乃自驕，令省事傳語。

translations.literal: Pusa then grew arrogant himself and had a clerk transmit words.
translations.idiomatic: Pusa then grew arrogant himself and had a clerk transmit words.

sentences.zh: 岳怒曰：「我與菩薩言，卿是何人，與我對語！

translations.literal: Yue angrily said, "I speak with Pusa—what kind of person are you to answer me!
translations.idiomatic: Yue angrily said, "I speak with Pusa—what kind of person are you to answer me!

sentences.zh: 」省事恃水，應答不遜。

translations.literal: " The clerk, relying on the water, answered insolently.
translations.idiomatic: " The clerk, relying on the water, answered insolently.

sentences.zh: 岳舉弓射之，應弦而倒。

translations.literal: Yue drew his bow and shot him; he fell at the twang of the string.
translations.idiomatic: Yue drew his bow and shot him; he fell at the twang of the string.

sentences.zh: 時已逼暮，於此各還。

translations.literal: It was already near dusk; at this each side returned.
translations.idiomatic: It was already near dusk; at this each side returned.

sentences.zh: 岳密於渭南傍水分置精騎，四十、五十以為一所，隨地形便，駱驛置之。

translations.literal: Yue secretly placed elite horsemen in separate groups of forty or fifty along the branches of water south of Weinan, posting them at intervals according to the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Yue secretly placed elite horsemen in separate groups of forty or fifty along the branches of water south of Weinan, posting them at intervals according to the terrain.

sentences.zh: 明日，自將百餘騎，隔水與賊相見，並且東行。

translations.literal: The next day he personally led more than a hundred horsemen, met the bandits across the water, and together moved eastward.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he personally led more than a hundred horsemen, met the bandits across the water, and together moved eastward.

sentences.zh: 岳漸前進，先所置騎隨岳而集。

translations.literal: Yue gradually advanced, and the horsemen he had posted earlier gathered as they followed Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Yue gradually advanced, and the horsemen he had posted earlier gathered as they followed Yue.

sentences.zh: [6]騎既漸增，賊不復測其多少。

translations.literal: [6] As the horsemen steadily increased, the bandits could no longer gauge their numbers.
translations.idiomatic: [6] As the horsemen steadily increased, the bandits could no longer gauge their numbers.

sentences.zh: 行二十里許，便至淺可濟，岳便馳馬東出，以示奔遁。

translations.literal: After traveling about twenty li they reached a shallow ford; Yue then galloped eastward, feigning flight.
translations.idiomatic: After traveling about twenty li they reached a shallow ford; Yue then galloped eastward, feigning flight.

sentences.zh: 賊謂岳走，乃棄步兵，南渡渭水，輕騎追岳。

translations.literal: The bandits thought Yue was fleeing, abandoned their infantry, crossed the Wei River southward, and sent light cavalry in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits thought Yue was fleeing, abandoned their infantry, crossed the Wei River southward, and sent light cavalry in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 岳東行十餘里，依橫崗伏兵以待之。

translations.literal: Yue traveled east more than ten li, then along a transverse ridge laid an ambush to await them.
translations.idiomatic: Yue traveled east more than ten li, then along a transverse ridge laid an ambush to await them.

sentences.zh: 賊以路險不得前進，前後繼至，半度崗東。

translations.literal: The bandits, because the road was difficult, could not advance; those behind kept arriving until half had crossed east of the ridge.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits, because the road was difficult, could not advance; those behind kept arriving until half had crossed east of the ridge.

sentences.zh: 岳乃回戰，身先士卒，急擊之，賊便退走。

translations.literal: Yue then turned to fight, leading the soldiers in person and pressing the attack fiercely; the bandits retreated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yue then turned to fight, leading the soldiers in person and pressing the attack fiercely; the bandits retreated and fled.

sentences.zh: 岳號令所部，賊下馬者皆不聽殺。

translations.literal: Yue ordered his command that any bandit who dismounted was not to be killed.
translations.idiomatic: Yue ordered his command that any bandit who dismounted was not to be killed.

sentences.zh: 賊顧見之，便悉投馬。

translations.literal: The bandits, looking back and seeing this, all threw themselves from their horses.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits, looking back and seeing this, all threw themselves from their horses.

sentences.zh: 俄而虜獲三千人，馬亦無遺。

translations.literal: In a short time three thousand captives were taken and not a horse was left.
translations.idiomatic: In a short time three thousand captives were taken and not a horse was left.

sentences.zh: 遂渡渭北，降步兵萬餘，收其輜重。

translations.literal: They then crossed north of the Wei, received the surrender of more than ten thousand infantry, and collected their baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: They then crossed north of the Wei, received the surrender of more than ten thousand infantry, and collected their baggage train.

sentences.zh: 其有土民，普皆勞遣。

translations.literal: As for the local people, all were consoled and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: As for the local people, all were consoled and sent away.

sentences.zh: 醜奴尋棄岐州，北走安定。

translations.literal: Chounu soon abandoned Qi Province and fled north to Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Chounu soon abandoned Qi Province and fled north to Anding.

sentences.zh: 其後，破侯伏侯元進，降侯機長貴，擒醜奴、蕭寶夤、王慶雲、万俟道洛，走宿勤明達，事在尒朱天光傳。

translations.literal: Thereafter he defeated Houfu Hou Yuanjin, received the surrender of Houji Changgui, captured Chounu, Xiao Baoyin, Wang Qingyun, and Wanqi Daoluo, and drove off Suqin Mingda—the account is given in Erzhu Tianguang's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he defeated Houfu Hou Yuanjin, received the surrender of Houji Changgui, captured Chounu, Xiao Baoyin, Wang Qingyun, and Wanqi Daoluo, and drove off Suqin Mingda—the account is given in Erzhu Tianguang's biography.

sentences.zh: 天光雖為元帥，而岳功效居多。

translations.literal: Although Tianguang was commander-in-chief, Yue's achievements were the greater part.
translations.idiomatic: Although Tianguang was commander-in-chief, Yue's achievements were the greater part.

sentences.zh: 加車騎將軍，增邑二千戶，進封樊城縣開國伯。

translations.literal: He was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry, his fief increased by two thousand households, and he was advanced to Baron of Fancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry, his fief increased by two thousand households, and he was advanced to Baron of Fancheng County.

sentences.zh: 尋詔岳都督涇、北豳、二夏四州諸軍事，本將軍，涇州刺史，進爵為公，改封清水郡公。

translations.literal: Soon an edict made Yue Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of the four provinces of Jing, Northern Bin, and the two Xia, with his existing rank, governor of Jing Province, promoted to Duke, with his title changed to Duke of Qingshui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict made Yue commander-in-chief over the military affairs of the four provinces of Jing, Northern Bin, and the two Xia, with his existing rank, governor of Jing Province, promoted to duke, with his title changed to Duke of Qingshui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 天光入洛，使岳行雍州事。

translations.literal: When Tianguang entered Luoyang, he had Yue act as governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianguang entered Luoyang, he had Yue act as governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 元曄立，除驃騎大將軍，增邑五百戶，餘如故。

translations.literal: When Yuan Ye was enthroned, Yue was appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry with his fief increased by five hundred households, the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Ye was enthroned, Yue was appointed grand general of agile cavalry with his fief increased by five hundred households, the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，都督二岐東秦三州諸軍事、儀同三司、岐州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai he was Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of the three provinces of the two Qi and Eastern Qin, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, and governor of Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he was commander-in-chief over the military affairs of the three provinces of the two Qi and Eastern Qin, equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, and governor of Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 尋加侍中，給後部鼓吹，仍詔開府。

translations.literal: Soon he was further made Palace Attendant, given rear guard musical instruments, and still ordered to open a grand command.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was further made palace attendant, given rear guard musical instruments, and still ordered to open a grand command.

sentences.zh: 俄兼尚書左僕射、隴右行臺，仍停高平。

translations.literal: Shortly he was made Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Commissioner of the Longyou Route, still halting at Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly he was made concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing and commissioner of the Longyou route, still halting at Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 後以隴中猶有土民不順，岳助侯莫陳悅所在討平。

translations.literal: Later, because there were still local people in Longzhong who were not compliant, Yue assisted Houmochen Yue in pacifying them wherever they were.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because there were still local people in Longzhong who were not compliant, Yue assisted Houmochen Yue in pacifying them wherever they were.

sentences.zh: 二年，加岳都督三雍、三秦、二岐、二華諸軍事，雍州刺史，關西行臺，餘如故。

translations.literal: In the second year Yue was further made Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of the three Yong, three Qin, two Qi, and two Hua provinces, governor of Yong Province, and Commissioner of the Guanzhong Route, with the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Yue was further made commander-in-chief over the military affairs of the three Yong, three Qin, two Qi, and two Hua provinces, governor of Yong Province, and commissioner of the Guanzhong route, with the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 及尒朱天光率眾赴洛，將抗齊獻武王，岳與侯莫陳悅下隴赴雍，以應義旗。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Tianguang led troops to Luoyang to resist King Xianwu of Qi, Yue and Houmochen Yue descended from Longyou to Yong to respond to the righteous banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Tianguang led troops to Luoyang to resist King Xianwu of Qi, Yue and Houmochen Yue descended from Longyou to Yong to respond to the righteous banner.

sentences.zh: 永熙初，仍開府、兼僕射、大行臺、雍州刺史，增邑千戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi he still held the grand command, was Concurrent Vice Director, Grand Commissioner, and governor of Yong Province, with his fief increased by one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongxi he still held the grand command, was concurrent vice director, grand commissioner, and governor of Yong Province, with his fief increased by one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔岳都督雍、華、北華、東雍、二岐、豳、四梁、二益、巴、二夏、蔚、寧、南益、涇二十州諸軍事，大都督。

translations.literal: In the second year an edict made Yue Grand Commander over the military affairs of twenty provinces—Yong, Hua, Northern Hua, Eastern Yong, the two Qi, Bin, the four Liang, the two Yi, Ba, the two Xia, Yu, Ning, Southern Yi, and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict made Yue grand commander over the military affairs of twenty provinces—Yong, Hua, Northern Hua, Eastern Yong, the two Qi, Bin, the four Liang, the two Yi, Ba, the two Xia, Yu, Ning, Southern Yi, and Jing.

sentences.zh: 岳自詣北境，安置邊防，率部趣涇州平涼西界，布營數十里，使諸軍士田殖涇州。

translations.literal: Yue personally went to the northern frontier, set the border defenses in order, led his command toward the western border of Pingliang in Jing Province, spread camps for several tens of li, and had the soldiers farm in Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Yue personally went to the northern frontier, set the border defenses in order, led his command toward the western border of Pingliang in Jing Province, spread camps for several tens of li, and had the soldiers farm in Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 身將壯勇，託以牧馬，於原州北招万俟受洛干等，并遠近州鎮聚結者。

translations.literal: He personally led the brave, under the pretext of herding horses, and north of Yuan Province recruited Wanqi Shouluogan and the others, together with those who gathered from near and distant provinces and garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: He personally led the brave, under the pretext of herding horses, and north of Yuan Province recruited Wanqi Shouluogan and the others, together with those who gathered from near and distant provinces and garrisons.

sentences.zh: 靈州刺史曹泥身詣岳軍請代，岳以前洛州刺史元季海為州。

translations.literal: Cao Ni, governor of Ling Province, came in person to Yue's army to request replacement; Yue made the former governor of Luoluo Province Yuan Jihai governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Ni, governor of Ling Province, came in person to Yue's army to request replacement; Yue made the former governor of Luoluo Province Yuan Jihai governor.

sentences.zh: 彼民不促，[7]擊破季海部下，獨聽季海。

translations.literal: The people there did not follow,[7] broke Jihai's subordinates, and allowed only Jihai himself.
translations.idiomatic: The people there did not follow,[7] broke Jihai's subordinates, and allowed only Jihai himself.

translations.literal: 〈Lacuna〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Lacuna〉

sentences.zh: 三年正月，岳召侯莫陳悅會於高平，將討之，令悅前驅，北趣靈州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Yue summoned Houmochen Yue to meet at Gaoping, planning to campaign against him; he ordered Yue as vanguard to advance north toward Ling Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year Yue summoned Houmochen Yue to meet at Gaoping, planning to campaign against him; he ordered Yue as vanguard to advance north toward Ling Province.

sentences.zh: 聞渴波隘中河水未解，將往趣之。

translations.literal: Hearing that in Kebobo Pass the river ice had not yet broken, he was about to go there.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that in Kebobo Pass the river ice had not yet broken, he was about to go there.

sentences.zh: 岳既總大眾，據制關右，憑強驕恣，有不臣之心。

translations.literal: Yue had already commanded the great host, controlled the Guanzhong region, relied on his strength and was arrogant and willful, and had the mind of a subject who would not serve.
translations.idiomatic: Yue had already commanded the great host, controlled the Guanzhong region, relied on his strength and was arrogant and willful, and had the mind of a subject who would not serve.

sentences.zh: 齊獻武王惡其專擅，令悅圖之。

translations.literal: King Xianwu of Qi hated his arbitrary power and ordered Houmochen Yue to plot against him.
translations.idiomatic: King Xianwu of Qi hated his arbitrary power and ordered Houmochen Yue to plot against him.

sentences.zh: 悅素服威略，既承密旨，便潛為計。

translations.literal: Yue had always submitted to his martial prowess; having received the secret order, he secretly made plans.
translations.idiomatic: Yue had always submitted to his martial prowess; having received the secret order, he secretly made plans.

sentences.zh: 時岳遣悅先行，悅乃通夜東進，達明晦日，岳行軍前與悅相見。

translations.literal: At that time Yue sent Houmochen Yue ahead; Yue then marched east through the night and on the day when light and dark met, as Yue's army advanced he met Yue.
translations.idiomatic: At that time He Bayue sent Houmochen Yue ahead; Houmochen Yue then marched east through the night and on the day when light and dark met, as He Bayue's army advanced he met Houmochen Yue.

sentences.zh: 悅誘岳入營，坐論兵事。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue lured He Bayue into camp and sat discussing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue lured He Bayue into camp and sat discussing military affairs.

sentences.zh: 悅詐云腹痛，起而徐行，悅女夫元洪景抽刀斬岳。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue feigned abdominal pain, rose and walked slowly; his son-in-law Yuan Hongjing drew a blade and beheaded He Bayue.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue feigned abdominal pain, rose and walked slowly; his son-in-law Yuan Hongjing drew a blade and beheaded He Bayue.

sentences.zh: 後岳部下收岳尸葬於雍州北石安原。

translations.literal: Later He Bayue's subordinates collected his corpse and buried it at Shianyuan north of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Later He Bayue's subordinates collected his corpse and buried it at Shianyuan north of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，贈大將軍、太保、錄尚書事，都督、刺史、開國並如故。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand General, Grand Mentor, and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing, with his command, governorship, and ducal title unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was posthumously enfeoffed as grand general, grand mentor, and recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing, with his command, governorship, and ducal title unchanged.

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳悅，代郡人也。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue was a man of Dai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue was a man of Dai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 父婆羅門，為駝牛都尉，故悅長於河西。

translations.literal: His father Boluomen was Director of Camel Oxen, and therefore Yue grew up in the Hexi region.
translations.idiomatic: His father Boluomen was director of camel oxen, and therefore Yue grew up in the Hexi region.

sentences.zh: 好田獵，便騎射。

translations.literal: He loved hunting and was skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: He loved hunting and was skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 會牧子逆亂，遂歸尒朱榮，榮引為都督府長流參軍，稍遷大都督。

translations.literal: When the herding peoples rebelled he joined Erzhu Rong; Rong brought him in as Chief Clerk of the Long Stream in the commandery staff and gradually promoted him to Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the herding peoples rebelled he joined Erzhu Rong; Rong brought him in as chief clerk of the long stream in the commandery staff and gradually promoted him to grand commander.

sentences.zh: 莊帝初，除征西將軍、金紫光祿大夫，封栢人縣開國侯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign he was appointed General Who Campaigns West, Grand Master of Golden Splendor and Purple Radiance, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Bairen County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign he was appointed General Who Campaigns West, Grand Master of Golden Splendor and Purple Radiance, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Bairen County with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 尒朱天光之討關西，榮以悅為天光右廂大都督，本官如故。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Tianguang campaigned against Guanxi, Rong made Yue Grand Commander of Tianguang's Right Wing, with his existing rank unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Tianguang campaigned against Guanxi, Rong made Yue grand commander of Tianguang's right wing, with his existing rank unchanged.

sentences.zh: 西伐克獲，皆與天光、賀拔岳略同勞效。

translations.literal: In the western campaign's captures and victories, his labor and merit were roughly the same as Tianguang's and He Bayue's.
translations.idiomatic: In the western campaign's captures and victories, his labor and merit were roughly the same as Tianguang's and He Bayue's.

sentences.zh: 以本將軍除鄯州刺史，餘如故。

translations.literal: With his existing rank he was appointed governor of Shan Province, with the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: With his existing rank he was appointed governor of Shan Province, with the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮死後，亦隨天光下隴。

translations.literal: After Erzhu Rong died he also followed Tianguang down from Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: After Erzhu Rong died he also followed Tianguang down from Longyou.

sentences.zh: 元曄立，除車騎大將軍、渭州刺史，進爵為公，改封白水郡，增邑五百戶。

translations.literal: When Yuan Ye was enthroned he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and governor of Wei Province, promoted to Duke, with his title changed to Duke of Baishui Commandery and his fief increased by five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Ye was enthroned he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and governor of Wei Province, promoted to duke, with his title changed to Duke of Baishui Commandery and his fief increased by five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 及天光向洛，使悅行華州事。

translations.literal: When Tianguang went toward Luoyang he had Yue act as governor of Hua Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianguang went toward Luoyang he had Yue act as governor of Hua Province.

sentences.zh: 普泰中，除驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、秦州刺史。

translations.literal: In Putai he was appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, and governor of Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: In Putai he was appointed grand general of agile cavalry, equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, and governor of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 天光之東出，將抗義旗，悅與岳下隴以應齊獻武王，至雍州，會尒朱覆敗。

translations.literal: When Tianguang marched east to resist the righteous banner, Yue and He Bayue descended from Longyou to respond to King Xianwu of Qi; reaching Yong Province, they met the Erzhu clan's total defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianguang marched east to resist the righteous banner, Yue and He Bayue descended from Longyou to respond to King Xianwu of Qi; reaching Yong Province, they met the Erzhu clan's total defeat.

sentences.zh: 永熙初，加開府、都督隴右諸軍事，仍秦州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi he was given the grand command and made Commander-in-Chief over the military affairs of Longyou, still governor of Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongxi he was given the grand command and made commander-in-chief over the military affairs of Longyou, still governor of Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 永熙三年正月，岳召悅共討靈州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Yongxi He Bayue summoned Houmochen Yue to campaign jointly against Ling Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Yongxi He Bayue summoned Houmochen Yue to campaign jointly against Ling Province.

sentences.zh: 悅誘岳斬之，岳左右奔散，悅遣人安慰云：「我別禀意旨，止在一人，諸君勿怖。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue lured He Bayue and beheaded him; He Bayue's attendants fled in all directions; Houmochen Yue sent men to console them, saying, "I received a separate order—only one man was the target; you need not fear.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue lured He Bayue and beheaded him; He Bayue's attendants fled in all directions; Houmochen Yue sent men to console them, saying, "I received a separate order—only one man was the target; you need not fear.

sentences.zh: 」眾皆畏服，無敢拒違。

translations.literal: " All were awed and submitted; none dared resist.
translations.idiomatic: " All were awed and submitted; none dared resist.

sentences.zh: 悅心猶豫，不即撫納，乃還入隴，止水洛城。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue's heart was hesitant and he did not immediately reassure and accept them; he returned into Longyou and halted at Shuilo city.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue's heart was hesitant and he did not immediately reassure and accept them; he returned into Longyou and halted at Shuilo city.

sentences.zh: 岳之所部，聚於平涼，規還圖悅，遣追夏州刺史宇文黑獺。

translations.literal: He Bayue's command gathered at Pingliang, planning to turn back and plot against Houmochen Yue; they sent to recall Xia Province governor Yuwen Heita.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayue's command gathered at Pingliang, planning to turn back and plot against Houmochen Yue; they sent to recall Xia Province governor Yuwen Heita.

sentences.zh: 黑獺至，遂總岳部眾并家口入高平城，以自安固。

translations.literal: When Heita arrived he then took command of He Bayue's troops together with their families and entered Gaoping city to secure himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Heita arrived he then took command of He Bayue's troops together with their families and entered Gaoping city to secure himself.

sentences.zh: 乃勒眾入隴征悅。

translations.literal: He then drove the host into Longyou to campaign against Houmochen Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He then drove the host into Longyou to campaign against Houmochen Yue.

sentences.zh: 悅聞之，棄城，南據山水之險，設陳候戰。

translations.literal: When Houmochen Yue heard this he abandoned the city, moved south to hold the peril of mountains and rivers, and set battle lines to await combat.
translations.idiomatic: When Houmochen Yue heard this he abandoned the city, moved south to hold the peril of mountains and rivers, and set battle lines to await combat.

sentences.zh: 黑獺至，遙望見悅，欲待明日決鬬。

translations.literal: When Heita arrived he saw Houmochen Yue from afar and wished to wait until the next day to decide the battle.
translations.idiomatic: When Heita arrived he saw Houmochen Yue from afar and wished to wait until the next day to decide the battle.

sentences.zh: 悅先召南秦州刺史李景和，其夜，景和遣人詣黑獺，密許翻降。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue first summoned Southern Qin Province governor Li Jinghe; that night Jinghe sent a man to Heita secretly promising to turn and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue first summoned Southern Qin Province governor Li Jinghe; that night Jinghe sent a man to Heita secretly promising to turn and surrender.

sentences.zh: 至暮，景和乃勒其所部使上驢駝，云「儀同有教，欲還秦州，守以拒賊」，令軍人嚴備。

translations.literal: At dusk Jinghe then drove his command to mount donkeys and camels, saying, "The Commissioner has orders to return to Qin Province and hold it against the bandits," and ordered the soldiers to arm themselves strictly.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk Jinghe then drove his command to mount donkeys and camels, saying, "The Commissioner has orders to return to Qin Province and hold it against the bandits," and ordered the soldiers to arm themselves strictly.

sentences.zh: 景和復紿悅帳下云：「儀同欲還秦州，汝等何不裝辦？

translations.literal: Jinghe again deceived Houmochen Yue's camp followers, saying, "The Commissioner wishes to return to Qin Province—why do you not prepare?
translations.idiomatic: Jinghe again deceived Houmochen Yue's camp followers, saying, "The Commissioner wishes to return to Qin Province—why do you not prepare?

sentences.zh: 」眾謂為實，以次相驚，人情惶惑，不可復止，皆散走而趣秦州。

translations.literal: " The crowd thought it was true; one after another they were alarmed; minds were confused and could no longer be stopped; all scattered and fled toward Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: " The crowd thought it was true; one after another they were alarmed; minds were confused and could no longer be stopped; all scattered and fled toward Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 景和先驅至城，據門以慰輯之。

translations.literal: Jinghe went ahead to the city first, seized the gate, and consoled and gathered them.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghe went ahead to the city first, seized the gate, and consoled and gathered them.

sentences.zh: 悅部眾離散，猜畏傍人，不聽左右近己，與其二弟并兒及謀殺岳者八九人棄軍迸走。

translations.literal: Houmochen Yue's command scattered; suspicious and fearful of those nearby, he would not allow attendants close to him; with his two younger brothers, his son, and the eight or nine men who had plotted He Bayue's murder he abandoned the army and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue's command scattered; suspicious and fearful of those nearby, he would not allow attendants close to him; with his two younger brothers, his son, and the eight or nine men who had plotted He Bayue's murder he abandoned the army and fled.

sentences.zh: 數日之中，盤回往來，不知所趣。

translations.literal: Within several days he wandered back and forth, not knowing where to go.
translations.idiomatic: Within several days he wandered back and forth, not knowing where to go.

sentences.zh: 左右勸向靈州，而悅不決，言下隴之後，恐有人所見。

translations.literal: Attendants urged him toward Ling Province, but Houmochen Yue could not decide, saying that after descending from Longyou he feared being seen by others.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants urged him toward Ling Province, but Houmochen Yue could not decide, saying that after descending from Longyou he feared being seen by others.

sentences.zh: 乃於山中令從者悉步，自乘一騾，欲向靈州。

translations.literal: Then in the mountains he ordered all followers to walk on foot while he himself rode a single mule, intending to go to Ling Province.
translations.idiomatic: Then in the mountains he ordered all followers to walk on foot while he himself rode a single mule, intending to go to Ling Province.

sentences.zh: 中路，追騎將及，望見之，遂縊死野中，弟、息、部下悉見擒殺，唯先謀殺岳者悅中兵參軍豆盧光走至靈州，後奔晉陽。

translations.literal: Midway, as pursuing horsemen were about to overtake him, they saw him from afar; he then hanged himself in the wild. His younger brother, son, and followers were all captured and killed; only Dou Luguang, Houmochen Yue's middle army aide who had first plotted He Bayue's murder, fled to Ling Province and later went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Midway, as pursuing horsemen were about to overtake him, they saw him from afar; he then hanged himself in the wild. His younger brother, son, and followers were all captured and killed; only Dou Luguang, Houmochen Yue's middle army aide who had first plotted He Bayue's murder, fled to Ling Province and later went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 悅自殺岳後，神情恍惚，不復如常，恒言：「我僅睡即夢見岳語我『兄欲何處去』，隨我不相置。

translations.literal: After Houmochen Yue killed He Bayue his spirit was confused and no longer as before; he constantly said, "When I barely sleep I dream that Yue says to me, 'Brother, where do you wish to go?'—he follows me and will not leave me.
translations.idiomatic: After Houmochen Yue killed He Bayue his spirit was confused and no longer as before; he constantly said, "When I barely sleep I dream that He Bayue says to me, 'Brother, where do you wish to go?'—he follows me and will not leave me.

sentences.zh: 」因此彌不自安，而致敗滅。

translations.literal: " Because of this he was ever more ill at ease and met ruin and destruction.
translations.idiomatic: " Because of this he was ever more ill at ease and met ruin and destruction.

sentences.zh: 侯淵，神武尖山人也。

translations.literal: Hou Yuan was a man of Shenwu Jianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Yuan was a man of Shenwu Jianshan.

sentences.zh: 機警有膽略。

translations.literal: He was alert and had courage and strategy.
translations.idiomatic: He was alert and had courage and strategy.

sentences.zh: 肅宗末年，六鎮飢亂，淵隨杜洛周南寇。

translations.literal: At the end of Emperor Suzong's reign the six garrisons suffered famine and disorder; Yuan followed Du Luozhou in raiding south.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Emperor Suzong's reign the six garrisons suffered famine and disorder; Yuan followed Du Luozhou in raiding south.

sentences.zh: 後與妻兄念賢背洛周歸尒朱榮。

translations.literal: Later, together with his wife's elder brother Nianxian, he turned against Luozhou and joined Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: Later, together with his wife's elder brother Nianxian, he turned against Luozhou and joined Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 路中遇寇，身披苫褐，榮賜其衣帽，厚待之，以淵為中軍副都督。

translations.literal: On the road they met bandits; he wore coarse hemp cloth; Rong gave him hat and clothes, treated him generously, and made Yuan Deputy Commander of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the road they met bandits; he wore coarse hemp cloth; Rong gave him hat and clothes, treated him generously, and made Yuan deputy commander of the central army.

sentences.zh: 常從征伐，屢有戰功。

translations.literal: He often followed on campaigns and repeatedly had battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: He often followed on campaigns and repeatedly had battle merit.

sentences.zh: 及莊帝還宮，榮令淵進討韓樓，配卒甚少。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang returned to the palace, Rong ordered Yuan to advance and campaign against Han Lou, assigning him very few troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang returned to the palace, Rong ordered Yuan to advance and campaign against Han Lou, assigning him very few troops.

sentences.zh: 或以為言，榮曰：「侯淵臨機設變，是其所長，若總大眾，未必能用。

translations.literal: Some spoke of this; Rong said, "Hou Yuan adapts to circumstances and sets stratagems—that is his strength; if he commanded a great host he might not be able to use it.
translations.idiomatic: Some spoke of this; Rong said, "Hou Yuan adapts to circumstances and sets stratagems—that is his strength; if he commanded a great host he might not be able to use it.

sentences.zh: 今擊此賊，故當不足定也。

translations.literal: In attacking this bandit, therefore, he should be more than enough to settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In attacking this bandit, therefore, he should be more than enough to settle the matter.

sentences.zh: 」止給騎七百。

translations.literal: " He gave him only seven hundred horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: " He gave him only seven hundred horsemen.

sentences.zh: 淵遂廣張軍聲，多設供具，親率數百騎，深入樓境，欲執行人以問虛實。

translations.literal: Yuan then greatly inflated his army's reputation, set out many supplies, personally led several hundred horsemen deep into Lou's territory, and wished to seize travelers to ask about conditions.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan then greatly inflated his army's reputation, set out many supplies, personally led several hundred horsemen deep into Lou's territory, and wished to seize travelers to ask about conditions.

sentences.zh: 去薊百餘里，值賊帥陳周馬步萬餘，淵遂潛伏以乘其背，大破之，虜其卒五千餘人。

translations.literal: More than a hundred li from Ji he encountered the bandit chief Chen Zhou with more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry; Yuan then lay in ambush and struck from behind, routing them greatly and capturing more than five thousand of his soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred li from Ji he encountered the bandit chief Chen Zhou with more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry; Yuan then lay in ambush and struck from behind, routing them greatly and capturing more than five thousand of his soldiers.

sentences.zh: 尋還其馬仗，縱令入城。

translations.literal: Soon he returned their horses and weapons and released them to enter the city.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he returned their horses and weapons and released them to enter the city.

sentences.zh: 左右諫曰：「既獲賊眾，何為復資遣之也？

translations.literal: Attendants remonstrated, saying, "Since we have captured the bandit force, why release and send them back?
translations.idiomatic: Attendants remonstrated, saying, "Since we have captured the bandit force, why release and send them back?

sentences.zh: 」淵曰：「我兵既少，不可力戰，事須為計以離隙之。

translations.literal: " Yuan said, "Our troops are few and we cannot fight by force; we must devise a plan to divide and estrange them.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuan said, "Our troops are few and we cannot fight by force; we must devise a plan to divide and estrange them.

sentences.zh: 」淵度其已至，遂率騎夜集，昧旦，叩其城門。

translations.literal: " Yuan estimated they had already arrived, then led horsemen to assemble by night; at dawn he knocked on the city gate.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuan estimated they had already arrived, then led horsemen to assemble by night; at dawn he knocked on the city gate.

sentences.zh: 韓樓果疑降卒為淵內應，遂遁走，追擒之。

translations.literal: Han Lou indeed suspected the surrendered soldiers were Yuan's agents within and fled; Yuan pursued and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Han Lou indeed suspected the surrendered soldiers were Yuan's agents within and fled; Yuan pursued and captured him.

sentences.zh: 以勳進爵為侯，增邑八百戶。

translations.literal: For merit he was promoted to Marquis with his fief increased by eight hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was promoted to marquis with his fief increased by eight hundred households.

sentences.zh: 尋詔淵以本將軍為平州刺史、大都督，仍鎮范陽。

translations.literal: Soon an edict made Yuan, with his existing rank, governor of Ping Province and Grand Commander, still garrisoning Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict made Yuan, with his existing rank, governor of Ping Province and grand commander, still garrisoning Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 及尒朱榮之死也，范陽太守盧文偉誘淵出獵，閉門拒之。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, the Administrator of Fanyang Lu Wenwei lured Yuan out hunting and closed the gates to refuse him.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, the administrator of Fanyang Lu Wenwei lured Yuan out hunting and closed the gates to refuse him.

sentences.zh: 淵率部曲屯於郡南，為榮舉哀，勒兵南向。

translations.literal: Yuan led his retainers to encamp south of the commandery, held mourning for Rong, and drove his troops south.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan led his retainers to encamp south of the commandery, held mourning for Rong, and drove his troops south.

sentences.zh: 莊帝使東萊王貴平為大使，慰勞燕薊。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuang sent Prince of Donglai Guiping as envoy to console and reassure Yan and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhuang sent Prince of Donglai Guiping as envoy to console and reassure Yan and Ji.

sentences.zh: 淵乃詐降，貴平信之，遂執貴平自隨。

translations.literal: Yuan then feigned surrender; Guiping believed him and was seized by Yuan and taken along.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan then feigned surrender; Guiping believed him and was seized by Yuan and taken along.

sentences.zh: 進至中山，行臺僕射魏蘭根邀擊之，為淵所敗。

translations.literal: Advancing to Zhongshan, the Forward Office Vice Director Wei Langen intercepted him and was defeated by Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Zhongshan, the forward office vice director Wei Langen intercepted him and was defeated by Yuan.

sentences.zh: 會元曄立，淵欲歸之。

translations.literal: When Yuan Ye was enthroned, Yuan wished to join him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Ye was enthroned, Yuan wished to join him.

sentences.zh: 常山太守甄楷屯據井陘，淵又擊破之。

translations.literal: The Administrator of Changshan Zhen Kai held Jingxing Pass; Yuan again defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: The administrator of Changshan Zhen Kai held Jingxing Pass; Yuan again defeated him.

sentences.zh: 曄乃授淵驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、定州刺史、左軍大都督、漁陽郡開國公，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: Ye then enfeoffed Yuan as Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, governor of Ding Province, Grand Commander of the Left Army, and Duke of Yuyang Commandery with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Ye then enfeoffed Yuan as grand general of agile cavalry, equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, governor of Ding Province, grand commander of the left army, and Duke of Yuyang Commandery with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 前廢帝立，仍加開府，餘如故。

translations.literal: When the deposed emperor was enthroned, Yuan was still given the grand command, with the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: When the deposed emperor was enthroned, Yuan was still given the grand command, with the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 幽州刺史劉靈助舉義兵，屯於安國城，淵與叱列延慶等破擒之。

translations.literal: The governor of You Province Liu Lingzhu raised righteous troops and encamped at Anguo city; Yuan together with Chilie Yanqing and the others broke and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: The governor of You Province Liu Lingzhu raised righteous troops and encamped at Anguo city; Yuan together with Chilie Yanqing and the others broke and captured him.

sentences.zh: 後隨尒朱兆拒義旗於廣阿，兆既敗走，淵降齊獻武王，後從王破尒朱於韓陵。

translations.literal: Later he followed Erzhu Zhao in resisting the righteous banner at Guang'a; when Zhao was defeated and fled, Yuan surrendered to King Xianwu of Qi, and later followed the king in defeating the Erzhu at Hanling.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Erzhu Zhao in resisting the righteous banner at Guang'a; when Zhao was defeated and fled, Yuan surrendered to King Xianwu of Qi, and later followed the king in defeating the Erzhu at Hanling.

sentences.zh: 永熙初，除齊州刺史，餘如故。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi he was appointed governor of Qi Province, with the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongxi he was appointed governor of Qi Province, with the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 出帝末，淵與兗州刺史樊子鵠、青州刺史東萊王貴平密信往來，以相連結，又遣間使通誠於獻武王。

translations.literal: At the end of the Deposed Emperor's reign Yuan exchanged secret letters with Fan Zihu, governor of Yan Province, and Prince of Donglai Guiping, governor of Qing Province, to join together, and also sent secret envoys to communicate his loyalty to King Xianwu.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Deposed Emperor's reign Yuan exchanged secret letters with Fan Zihu, governor of Yan Province, and Prince of Donglai Guiping, governor of Qing Province, to join together, and also sent secret envoys to communicate his loyalty to King Xianwu.

sentences.zh: 及出帝入關，復懷顧望。

translations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor entered the passes, Yuan again wavered and looked back.
translations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor entered the passes, Yuan again wavered and looked back.

sentences.zh: 汝陽王暹既除齊州刺史，次於城西，淵擁部據城，不時迎納。

translations.literal: After Prince of Runan Xian was removed as governor of Qi Province and halted west of the city, Yuan held his command and seized the city, not promptly welcoming and admitting him.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince of Runan Xian was removed as governor of Qi Province and halted west of the city, Yuan held his command and seized the city, not promptly welcoming and admitting him.

sentences.zh: 民劉桃符等潛引暹入據西城，淵爭門不克，率騎出奔，妻兒部曲為暹所虜。

translations.literal: The commoner Liu Taofu and others secretly led Xian in to hold the western city; Yuan contested the gate but could not take it, led horsemen and fled, and his wife, children, and retainers were captured by Xian.
translations.idiomatic: The commoner Liu Taofu and others secretly led Xian in to hold the western city; Yuan contested the gate but could not take it, led horsemen and fled, and his wife, children, and retainers were captured by Xian.

sentences.zh: 行達廣里，會承制以淵行青州事。

translations.literal: On the road he reached Guangli; he happened to receive an interim appointment making Yuan acting governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the road he reached Guangli; he happened to receive an interim appointment making Yuan acting governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 齊獻武王又遺淵書曰：「卿勿以部曲輕少，難於東邁。

translations.literal: King Xianwu of Qi also sent Yuan a letter saying, "Do not think your command too small and light to march east.
translations.idiomatic: King Xianwu of Qi also sent Yuan a letter saying, "Do not think your command too small and light to march east.

sentences.zh: 齊人澆薄，唯利是從，齊州城民尚能迎汝陽王，青州之人豈不能開門待卿也。

translations.literal: The people of Qi are fickle and follow profit; the city people of Qi Province were still able to welcome Prince of Runan—how could the people of Qing Province not open the gates and await you?
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qi are fickle and follow profit; the city people of Qi Province were still able to welcome Prince of Runan—how could the people of Qing Province not open the gates and await you?

sentences.zh: 但當勉之。

translations.literal: You need only exert yourself.
translations.idiomatic: You need only exert yourself.

sentences.zh: 」淵乃復還，暹始歸其部曲。

translations.literal: " Yuan then returned; Xian at last returned his command.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuan then returned; Xian at last returned his command.

sentences.zh: 而貴平自以斛斯椿黨，亦不受代。

translations.literal: Guiping, considering himself an ally of Hu Sichun, also would not accept replacement.
translations.idiomatic: Guiping, considering himself an ally of Hu Sichun, also would not accept replacement.

sentences.zh: 淵進襲高陽郡，克之，置部曲家累於城中，身率輕騎遊掠於外。

translations.literal: Yuan advanced and raided Gaoyang Commandery, captured it, placed his retainers' families in the city, and personally led light cavalry to raid and plunder outside.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan advanced and raided Gaoyang Commandery, captured it, placed his retainers' families in the city, and personally led light cavalry to raid and plunder outside.

sentences.zh: 貴平使其長子率眾攻高陽，南青州刺史茹懷朗遣兵助之。

translations.literal: Guiping sent his eldest son to lead troops to attack Gaoyang; Ru Huailang, governor of Southern Qing Province, sent troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Guiping sent his eldest son to lead troops to attack Gaoyang; Ru Huailang, governor of Southern Qing Province, sent troops to assist.

sentences.zh: 時青州城人餽糧者首尾相繼。

translations.literal: At that time the people of Qing Province bringing grain came one after another in an unbroken line.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the people of Qing Province bringing grain came one after another in an unbroken line.

sentences.zh: 淵親率騎夜趣青州，詐餽糧人曰：「臺軍已至，殺戮都盡，我是世子下人，今已走還城，汝何為復去也？

translations.literal: Yuan personally led horsemen by night toward Qing Province and deceived the grain-bearers, saying, "The imperial army has already arrived and slaughtered everyone; I am a man under the heir—now I have fled back to the city; why do you still go away?
translations.idiomatic: Yuan personally led horsemen by night toward Qing Province and deceived the grain-bearers, saying, "The imperial army has already arrived and slaughtered everyone; I am a man under the heir—now I have fled back to the city; why do you still go away?

sentences.zh: 」人信其言，棄糧奔走。

translations.literal: " The people believed his words, abandoned their grain, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: " The people believed his words, abandoned their grain, and fled.

sentences.zh: 比曉，復謂行人曰：「臺軍昨夜已至高陽，我是前鋒，今始到此，頗知侯公竟在何處？

translations.literal: By dawn he again said to travelers, "The imperial army last night already reached Gaoyang; I am the vanguard and have only now arrived here—do you know where Lord Hou actually is?
translations.idiomatic: By dawn he again said to travelers, "The imperial army last night already reached Gaoyang; I am the vanguard and have only now arrived here—do you know where Lord Hou actually is?

sentences.zh: 」城人兇懼，遂執貴平出降。

translations.literal: " The city people were terrified and seized Guiping to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: " The city people were terrified and seized Guiping to surrender.

sentences.zh: 淵自惟反覆，慮不獲安，遂斬貴平，傳首京師，欲明不同於斛斯椿也。

translations.literal: Yuan, reflecting on his own repeated shifts, feared he would not be secure and therefore beheaded Guiping, sent his head to the capital, wishing to show he was not like Hu Sichun.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan, reflecting on his own repeated shifts, feared he would not be secure and therefore beheaded Guiping, sent his head to the capital, wishing to show he was not like Hu Sichun.

sentences.zh: 及子鵠平，詔以封延之為青州刺史。

translations.literal: When Zihu was pacified, an edict made Feng Yanzhi governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Zihu was pacified, an edict made Feng Yanzhi governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 淵既不獲州任，情又恐懼，行達廣川，遂劫光州庫兵反。

translations.literal: Yuan, not obtaining the provincial appointment and again fearful, reached Guangchuan on the road and then seized the Guang Province armory troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan, not obtaining the provincial appointment and again fearful, reached Guangchuan on the road and then seized the Guang Province armory troops in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 遣騎詣平原，執前膠州刺史賈璐。

translations.literal: He sent horsemen to Pingyuan and seized the former governor of Jiao Province Jia Lu.
translations.idiomatic: He sent horsemen to Pingyuan and seized the former governor of Jiao Province Jia Lu.

sentences.zh: 夜襲青州南郭，劫前廷尉卿崔光韶，以惑人情。

translations.literal: By night he raided the southern ward of Qing Province and seized the former Minister of Justice Cui Guangshao to confuse popular sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: By night he raided the southern ward of Qing Province and seized the former Minister of Justice Cui Guangshao to confuse popular sentiment.

sentences.zh: 攻掠郡縣。

translations.literal: He attacked and plundered commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked and plundered commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 其部下督帥叛拒之，淵率騎奔蕭衍，途中亡散，行達南青州南境，為賣漿者斬之，傳首京師，家口配沒。

translations.literal: His subordinate commanders rebelled and resisted him; Yuan led horsemen and fled to Xiao Yan; on the road his force scattered and dissolved; reaching the southern border of Southern Qing Province he was beheaded by a syrup seller, his head sent to the capital, and his family enslaved.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinate commanders rebelled and resisted him; Yuan led horsemen and fled to Xiao Yan; on the road his force scattered and dissolved; reaching the southern border of Southern Qing Province he was beheaded by a syrup seller, his head sent to the capital, and his family enslaved.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：朱瑞以背本向義，責不見原。

translations.literal: The historian says: Zhu Rui, for turning from his original allegiance toward righteousness, was blamed and not forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: Zhu Rui, for turning from his original allegiance toward righteousness, was blamed and not forgiven.

sentences.zh: 延慶黨舊違順，常刑所及。

translations.literal: Yanqing, as an old partisan, violated compliance and submission—the ordinary penalty reached him.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing, as an old partisan, violated compliance and submission—the ordinary penalty reached him.

sentences.zh: 斛斯椿姦佞為心，讒忒自口，取譬蒼蠅，交亂四國，投於豺虎，天實棄之。

translations.literal: Hu Sichun had treachery and sycophancy in his heart and slander and perversity on his tongue; like the fly, he stirred chaos in the four states; cast to the jackals and tigers, Heaven truly abandoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sichun had treachery and sycophancy in his heart and slander and perversity on his tongue; like the fly, he stirred chaos in the four states; cast to the jackals and tigers, Heaven truly abandoned him.

sentences.zh: 賈智、侯淵反覆取斃。

translations.literal: Jia Zhi and Hou Yuan, shifting sides repeatedly, met their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhi and Hou Yuan, shifting sides repeatedly, met their deaths.

sentences.zh: 破胡器小謀大，終於顛蹶。

translations.literal: Pohu had a small vessel but great designs and ultimately stumbled and fell.
translations.idiomatic: Pohu had a small vessel but great designs and ultimately stumbled and fell.

sentences.zh: 子鵠迷機寡算，竟以殲殄。

translations.literal: Zihu lost his way in opportunity and had little calculation, and in the end was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Zihu lost his way in opportunity and had little calculation, and in the end was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 岳負力無謀，制以一劍。

translations.literal: Yue relied on strength without strategy and was controlled by a single sword.
translations.idiomatic: He Bayue relied on strength without strategy and was controlled by a single sword.

sentences.zh: 悅果行慮淺，死不旋足。

translations.literal: Yue was rash in action and shallow in planning; death came before he could turn his feet.
translations.idiomatic: Houmochen Yue was rash in action and shallow in planning; death came before he could turn his feet.

sentences.zh: 觀其亡滅，自取之也。

translations.literal: Observing their ruin and extinction, they brought it on themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Observing their ruin and extinction, they brought it on themselves.

translations.idiomatic: On the posthumous promotion from General of Awesome Prestige to General of Chariots and Cavalry: in various editions 威 is written as 城.

translations.literal: On the governor Yuan Xianda surrendering the city to Xiao Yan: according to Liang shu juan 39 there is a biography of Yuan Yuanda, who is this man; Liang shu juan 3, Annals of Emperor Gaozu, entry for the fourth month xinchou of the second year of Datong, and juan 28, biography of Xiahou Tan, all write "Yuanda".
translations.idiomatic: On the governor Yuan Xianda surrendering the city to Xiao Yan: according to Liang shu juan 39 there is a biography of Yuan Yuanda, who is this man; Liang shu juan 3, Annals of Emperor Gaozu, entry for the fourth month xinchou of the second year of Datong, and juan 28, biography of Xiahou Tan, all write "Yuanda".

sentences.zh: 據梁書本傳，其人為樂平王丕後裔，今魏書卷一七已闕，後人所補，丕傳不載子孫。

translations.literal: According to the main biography in Liang shu, this man was a descendant of Prince of Leping Pi; juan 17 of the present Book of Wei is missing and was supplemented by later men; Pi's biography does not record his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: According to the main biography in Liang shu, this man was a descendant of Prince of Leping Pi; juan 17 of the present Book of Wei is missing and was supplemented by later men; Pi's biography does not record his descendants.

translations.idiomatic: The three places in Liang shu all write "Yuanda"; the character 顯 is probably corrupt.

translations.idiomatic: On Zhao Xiuyan rising in rebellion in Jing Province: in various editions 延 is written as 巡.
