translations.literal: has only "Zuo city", the same as Cefu.
translations.idiomatic: has only "Zuo city", the same as Cefu.

sentences.zh: 隋書卷三一地理志下襄陽郡陰城縣下云：「西魏置酇城郡。

translations.literal: Sui shu juan 31, Geography Monograph, under Yincheng County in Xiangyang Commandery, says: "Western Wei established Zuo city Commandery."
translations.idiomatic: Sui shu juan 31, Geography Monograph, under Yincheng County in Xiangyang Commandery, says: "Western Wei established Zuo city Commandery."

sentences.zh: 」西魏當因梁舊名。

translations.literal: " Western Wei presumably followed the Liang old name.
translations.idiomatic: " Western Wei presumably followed the Liang old name.

sentences.zh: 歐陽，見本書卷五八楊播附楊侃傳，地在合肥，壽春間，或沔北別有此城。

translations.literal: Ouyang appears in juan 58 of this book, biography of Yang Bo with appended biography of Yang Kan; the place is near Hefei, between Shouchun—perhaps north of the Mian there was another such city.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang appears in juan 58 of this book, biography of Yang Bo with appended biography of Yang Kan; the place is near Hefei, between Shouchun—perhaps north of the Mian there was another such city.

sentences.zh: 「酇陽」不見紀載，這裏當衍「陽」字。

translations.literal: "Zunyang" is not found in records; here the character 陽 is probably an interpolation.
translations.idiomatic: "Zunyang" is not found in records; here the character 陽 is probably an interpolation.

sentences.zh: 如周書不誤，則也可能是「歐陽、酇城」的倒脫。

translations.literal: If Zhou shu is not in error, it may also be an inversion and omission of "Ouyang and Zuo city".
translations.idiomatic: If Zhou shu is not in error, it may also be an inversion and omission of "Ouyang and Zuo city".

sentences.zh: 岳屆長安榮遣兵續至 諸本「兵」作「岳」。

translations.literal: When Yue reached Chang'an, Rong sent troops to follow: in various editions "兵" is written as "岳".
translations.idiomatic: When Yue reached Chang'an, Rong sent troops to follow: in various editions 兵 is written as 岳.

sentences.zh: 按既云「岳屆長安」，又云「遣岳續至」，語不可通。

translations.literal: Since it already says "Yue reached Chang'an" and then says "sent Yue to follow", the language cannot cohere.
translations.idiomatic: Since it already says "Yue reached Chang'an" and then says "sent Yue to follow", the language cannot cohere.

sentences.zh: 卷七五尒朱天光傳稱「榮復遣軍士二千人以赴」，即指此事。

translations.literal: Juan 75, biography of Erzhu Tianguang, says "Rong again sent two thousand soldiers to go to his aid"—this refers to that event.
translations.idiomatic: Juan 75, biography of Erzhu Tianguang, says "Rong again sent two thousand soldiers to go to his aid"—this refers to that event.

sentences.zh: 這裏「岳」乃「兵」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Here 岳 is a corruption of 兵; it is corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: Here 岳 is a corruption of 兵; it is corrected here.

sentences.zh: 先所置騎隨岳而集 諸本「騎」上有「驛」字，周書卷一四、北史卷四九賀拔岳傳、通典卷一五四引退設伏取之條無。

translations.literal: The horsemen posted earlier gathered as they followed Yue: in various editions above 騎 there is the character 驛; Zhou shu juan 14, Beishi juan 49, biography of He Bayue, and Tongdian juan 154 citing the passage on setting an ambush in retreat do not have it.
translations.idiomatic: The horsemen posted earlier gathered as they followed Yue: in various editions above 騎 there is the character 驛; Zhou shu juan 14, Beishi juan 49, biography of He Bayue, and Tongdian juan 154 citing the passage on setting an ambush in retreat do not have it.

sentences.zh: 按「驛」字乃涉上文「駱驛置之」語而衍，今據刪。

translations.literal: The character 驛 is an interpolation from the phrase "posted at intervals" above; it is deleted here on that evidence.
translations.idiomatic: The character 驛 is an interpolation from the phrase "posted at intervals" above; it is deleted here on that evidence.

sentences.zh: 彼民不促 按「促」字不可解，疑是「從」之訛。

translations.literal: The people there did not follow: the character 促 cannot be explained; it is probably a corruption of 從.
translations.idiomatic: The people there did not follow: the character 促 cannot be explained; it is probably a corruption of 從.
